:= n.txnSeq\n\tn.balance -= amount\n\tn.send(msg.Message{Kind: msg.Data, From: n.id, To: to, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn})\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"send_req\", Peer: to, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn, Balance: n.balance})\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// Receive 处理一条投递到本节点的业务消息。dup 表示这是网络重复副本。\nfunc (n *Node) Receive(m msg.Message, at int64, dup bool) {\n\tif m.To != n.id {\n\t\tpanic(fmt.Sprintf(\"bank: 消息投递给错误的节点 %d（目标 %d）\", n.id, m.To))\n\t}\n\tif !m.IsReply {\n\t\t// REQ：重复事务直接丢弃，不重复入账。\n\t\tif n.seenReq[m.TxnID] {\n\t\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"drop_dup\", Peer: m.From, Amount: m.Amount, TxnID: m.TxnID, Balance: n.balance,\n\t\t\t\tNote: \"重复转账请求，已忽略\"})\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.seenReq[m.TxnID] = true\n\t\tn.balance += n.id, m.From\n\t\tn.send(ack)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// ACK：重复副本幂等忽略。\n\tif n.seenAck[m.TxnID] {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"drop_dup\", Peer: m.From, Amount: m.Amount, TxnID: m.TxnID, {"parentUuid":"7dbbced1-5d40-471e-a8b6-bbd895bf75f2","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_b6cb0ym96rcb2vfjf0kfpq21","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp30/b/internal/app/api.go","content":"// Package app 负责把 JSON 请求装配成“离散事件引擎 + 网络 + 银行节点 + 快照管理器”，\n// 运行后输出可序列化的 JSON 结果。\npackage app\n\nimport (\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\n\t\"simsnap/internal/sim\"\n)\n\n// LinkSpec 指定一条链路及其策略。\ntype LinkSpec struct {\n\tA      int        `json:\"a\"`\n\tB      int        `json:\"b\"`\n\tPolicy sim.Policy `json:\"policy\"`\n}\n\n// TransferEvent 是脚本化的一笔转账：At 时刻 From -> To，金额 Amount。\ntype TransferEvent struct {\n\tAt     int64 `json:\"at\"`\n\tFrom   int   `json:\"from\"`\n\tTo     int   `json:\"to\"`\n\tAmount int   `json:\"amount\"`\n}\n\n// SnapshotEvent 是脚本化的一次快照发起。\ntype SnapshotEvent struct {\n\tAt        int64 `json:\"at\"`\n\tID        int   `json:\"id\"`\n\tInitiator int   `json:\"initiator\"`\n}\n\n// TrafficSpec 请求在 [From, Until] 内每 Every 个时间单位发起一笔随机转账\n// （随机源来自引擎种子，因此完全可复现）。\ntype TrafficSpec struct {\n\tFrom      int64 `json:\"from\"`\n\tUntil     int64 `json:\"until\"`\n\tEvery     int64 `json:\"every\"`\n\tMaxAmount int   `json:\"max_amount\"`\n}\n\n// Request 是一次模拟运行的完整输入。\ntype Request struct {\n\tSeed          int64           `json:\"seed\"`\n\tBalances      []int           `json:\"balances\"`       // 各节点初始余额（长度即节点数）\n\tDefaultPolicy *sim.Policy     `json:\"default_policy\"` // 未在 links 中显式给出的链路使用此策略\n\tLinks         []LinkSpec      `json:\"links,omitempty\"`\n\tTransfers     []TransferEvent `json:\"transfers,omitempty\"`\n\tSnapshots     []SnapshotEvent `json:\"snapshots,omitempty\"`\n\tTraffic       *TrafficSpec    `json:\"traffic,omitempty\"`\n\tDeadline      int64           `json:\"deadline,omitempty\"` // 仿真截止时刻；0 表示跑到事件队列清空\n}\n\n// Validate 校验请求并返回归一化后的每条链路策略（键 \"a-b\", a<b）。\nfunc (r *Request) Validate() (map[string]sim.Policy, error) {\n\tn := len(r.Balances)\n\tif n < 2 {\n\t\treturn nil, errors.New(\"balances 至少需要 2 个节点\")\n\t}\n\tfor i, b := range r.Balances {\n\t\tif b < 0 {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"balances[%d] 不能为负\", i)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif r.DefaultPolicy == nil && len(r.Links) == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil, errors.New(\"必须提供 default_policy 或 links\")\n\t}\n\tif r.DefaultPolicy != nil {\n\t\tif err := validatePolicy(*r.DefaultPolicy); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"default_policy: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tout := map[string]sim.Policy{}\n\tif r.DefaultPolicy != nil {\n\t\tfor a := 0; a < n; a++ {\n\t\t\tfor b := a + 1; b < n; b++ {\n\t\t\t\tout[pairKey(a, b)] = *r.DefaultPolicy\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tseen := map[string]bool{}\n\tfor _, l := range r.Links {\n\t\tif l.A < 0 || l.A >= n || l.B < 0 || l.B >= n {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"link %d-%d 节点越界\", l.A, l.B)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif l.A == l.B {\n\t\t\treturn nil, errors.New(\"不允许自环链路\")\n\t\t}\n\t\tkey := pairKey(l.A, l.B)\n\t\tif seen[key] {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"link %d-%d 重复指定\", l.A, l.B)\n\t\t}\n\t\tseen[key] = true\n\t\tif err := validatePolicy(l.Policy); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"link %d-%d: %w\", l.A, l.B, err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tout[key] = l.Policy\n\t}\n\t// default 与显式 links 合并后仍需覆盖全互联拓扑。\n\tfor a := 0; a < n; a++ {\n\t\tfor b := a + 1; b < n; b++ {\n\t\t\tif _, ok := out[pairKey(a, b)]; !ok {\n\t\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"节点 %d 与 %d 之间缺少链路策略（且无 default_policy）\", a, b)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tseenSnap := map[int]bool{}\n\tfor _, s := range r.Snapshots {\n\t\tif s.ID < 1 {\n\t\t\treturn nil, errors.New(\"snapshot id 必须 >= 1\")\n\t\t}\n\t\tif seenSnap[s.ID] {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"snapshot id %d 重复\", s.ID)\n\t\t}\n\t\tseenSnap[s.ID] = true\n\t\tif s.Initiator < 0 || s.Initiator >= n {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"snapshot %d initiator 越界\", s.ID)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tfor _, t := range r.Transfers {\n\t\tif t.From < 0 || t.From >= n || t.To < 0 || t.To >= n {\n\t\t\treturn nil, errors.New(\"transfer 节点越界\")\n\t\t}\n\t\tif t.From == t.To {\n\t\t\treturn nil, errors.New(\"不允许自己给自己转账\")\n\t\t}\n\t\tif t.Amount <= 0 {\n\t\t\treturn nil, errors.New(\"transfer 金额必须为正\")\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif r.Traffic != nil {\n\t\tt := r.Traffic\n\t\tif t.Every < 1 {\n\t\t\treturn nil, errors.New(\"traffic.every 必须 >= 1\")\n\t\t}\n\t\tif t.MaxAmount < 1 {\n\t\t\treturn nil, errors.New(\"traffic.max_amount 必须 >= 1\")\n\t\t}\n\t\tif t.Until < t.From {\n\t\t\treturn nil, errors.New(\"traffic.until 不能小于 from\")\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r.Deadline <= 0 {\n\t\t\treturn nil, errors.New(\"启用持续流量 traffic 时必须设置 deadline 以保证运行终止\")\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn out, nil\n}\n\nfunc validatePolicy(p sim.Policy) error {\n\tif p.MinDelay < 1 {\n\t\treturn errors.New(\"min_delay 必须 >= 1\")\n\t}\n\tif p.MaxDelay < p.MinDelay {\n\t\treturn errors.New(\"max_delay 不能小于 min_delay\")\n\t}\n\tif p.LossPct < 0 || p.LossPct > 100 || p.DupPct < 0 || p.DupPct > app\n\nimport (\n\t\"sort\"\n\n\t\"simsnap/internal/bank\"\n\t\"simsnap/internal/msg\"\n\t\"simsnap/internal/sim\"\n\t\"simsnap/internal/snap\"\n)\n\n// EventKind 枚举输出日志中的事件类型。\nconst (\n\tEvScheduleTransfer = \"schedule_transfer\"\n\tEvInsufficient     = \"insufficient\"\n\tEvSend             = \"send\"\n\tEvDeliver          = \"deliver\"\n\tEvMarkerSend       = \"marker_send\"\n\tEvMarkerDeliver    = \"marker_deliver\"\n\tEvCaptured         = \"snap_captured\"\n\tEvInitiate         = \"snap_initiate\"\n\tEvComplete         = \"snap_complete\"\n)\n\n// LogEvent 是时间线日志条目。\ntype LogEvent struct {\n\tAt       int64  `json:\"at\"`\n\tKind     string `json:\"kind\"`\n\tSnapID   int    `json:\"snap_id,omitempty\"`\n\tFrom     int    `json:\"from,omitempty\"`\n\tTo       int    `json:\"to,omitempty\"`\n\tAmount   int    `json:\"amount,omitempty\"`\n\tTxnID    int64  `json:\"txn_id,omitempty\"`\n\tIsReply  bool   `json:\"is_reply,omitempty\"`\n\tSendID   int    `json:\"send_id,omitempty\"`\n\tDup      bool   `json:\"dup,omitempty\"`\n\tNote     string `json:\"note,omitempty\"`\n\tBalances []int  `json:\"balances,omitempty\"` // 仅 snap_complete：完成时刻各节点余额\n}\n\n// SnapshotResult 是单次快照的结果。\ntype SnapshotResult struct {\n\tSnapshot snap.Snapshot `json:\"snapshot\"`\n\tNodeSum  int           `json:\"node_sum\"`             // 记录状态中余额之和\n\tInFlight int           `json:\"in_flight\"`            // 在途 REQ 金额之和\n\tTotal    int           `json:\"total\"`                // node_sum + in_flight\n\tExpected int           `json:\"expected\"`             // 初始总余额（守恒参照）\n\tConserved bool         `json:\"conserved\"`            // total == expected\n}\n\n// BalanceEntry 是结束时某节点余额。\ntype BalanceEntry struct {\n\tNode    int `json:\"node\"`\n\tBalance int `json:\"balance\"`\n}\n\n// LinkStat 是一条有向信道的结束统计。\ntype LinkStat struct {\n\tFrom int        `json:\"from\"`\n\tTo   int        `json:\"to\"`\n\tStats sim.Stats `json:\"stats\"`\n}\n\n// Response 是一次模拟运行的输出。\ntype Response struct {\n\tSeed            int64            `json:\"seed\"`\n\tNow             int64            `json:\"now\"`\n\tDeadline        int64            `json:\"deadline\"`\n\tInitialTotal    int              `json:\"initial_total\"`\n\tFinalBalances   []BalanceEntry   `json:\"final_balances\"`\n\tFinalTotal      int              `json:\"final_total\"`\n\tSnapshots       []SnapshotResult `json:\"snapshots\"`\n\tNetwork         []LinkStat       `json:\"network\"`\n\tEvents          []LogEvent       `json:\"events\"`\n\tStoppedDeadline bool             `json:\"stopped_by_deadline,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Run 执行请求并返回结果。请求必须已通过 Validate。\nfunc Run(r *Request) *Response {\n\tn := len(r.Balances)\n\teng := sim.NewEngine(r.Seed)\n\tif r.Deadline > 0 {\n\t\teng.SetDeadline(r.Deadline)\n\t}\n\tnetw := sim.NewNetwork(eng)\n\tpolicies, _ := r.Validate()\n\tfor key, p := range policies {\n\t\tvar a, b int\n\t\tfmtSscan(key, &a, &b)\n\t\tnetw.AddLink(a, b, p)\n\t}\n\n\tevents := []LogEvent{}\n\tlogf := func(e LogEvent) { events = append(events, e) }\n\n\tnodes := make([]*bank.Node, n)\n\tsend := func(m msg.Message) {\n\t\tnetw.Send(m, func(d sim.Delivery) {\n\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: d.At, Kind: EvDeliver, From: d.Msg.From, To: d.Msg.To,\n\t\t\t\tAmount: d.Msg.Amount, TxnID: d.Msg.TxnID, IsReply: d.Msg.IsReply,\n\t\t\t\tSendID: d.SendID, Dup: d.Dup})\n\t\t\tif d.Msg.IsMarker() {\n\t\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: d.At, Kind: EvMarkerDeliver, SnapID: d.Msg.SnapID,\n\t\t\t\t\tFrom: d.Msg.From, To: d.Msg.To, SendID: d.SendID, Dup: d.Dup})\n\t\t\t\tmgr.MarkerReceived(d.Msg.SnapID, d.Msg.From, d.Msg.To, d.At)\n\t\t\t\tif mgr.IsComplete(d.Msg.SnapID) {\n\t\t\t\t\tlogComplete(d.Msg.SnapID, d.At)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t// Chandy–Lamport：先让快照管理器判定在途归属，再执行业务状态变更。\n\t\t\tcaptured := mgr.DataReceived(d.Msg.From, d.Msg.To, d.Msg)\n\t\t\tfor _, sid := range captured {\n\t\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: d.At, Kind: EvCaptured, SnapID: sid, From: d.Msg.From, To: d.Msg.To,\n\t\t\t\t\tAmount: d.Msg.Amount, TxnID: d.Msg.TxnID, IsReply: d.Msg.IsReply})\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tnodes[d.Msg.To].Receive(d.Msg, d.At, d.Dup)\n\t\t})\n\t\tkind := EvSend\n\t\tif m.IsMarker() {\n\t\t\tkind = EvMarkerSend\n\t\t}\n\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: eng.Now(), Kind: kind, SnapID: m.SnapID, From: m.From, To: m.To,\n\t\t\tAmount: m.Amount, TxnID: m.TxnID, IsReply: m.IsReply})\n\t}\n\tfor i := 0; i < n; i++ {\n\t\ti := i\n\t\tnodes[i] = bank.New(i, r.Balances[i], send, func(ev bank.Event) {\n\t\t\tif ev.Kind == \"insufficient\" {\n\t\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: ev.At, Kind: EvInsufficient, From: ev.Node, To: ev.Peer,\n\t\t\t\t\tAmount: ev.Amount, Note: ev.Note})\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\n\tstateOf := func(node int) any { return nodes[node].SnapshotState() }\n\tmgr := snap.NewManager(n, func(from, to, snapID int) {\n\t\tsend(msg.Message{Kind: msg.Marker, SnapID: snapID, From: from, To: to})\n\t}, stateOf)\n\n\tlogComplete = func(id int, at int64) {\n\t\tif !mgr.IsComplete(id) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\t// 仅在“此前未完成”时记录一次。\n\t\tfor _, e := range events {\n\t\t\tif e.Kind == EvComplete && e.SnapID == id {\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tbs := make([]int, n)\n\t\tfor i, nd := range nodes {\n\t\t\tbs[i] = nd.Balance()\n\t\t}\n\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: at, Kind: EvComplete, SnapID: id, Balances: bs})\n\t}\n\n\tinitialTotal := 0\n\tfor _, b := range r.Balances {\n\t\tinitialTotal += b\n\t}\n\n\t// 脚本化事件：先排序保证调度顺序确定（同刻快照优先于转账）。\n\ttransfers := append([]TransferEvent(nil), r.Transfers...)\n\tsort.SliceStable(transfers, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\tif transfers[i].At != transfers[j].At {\n\t\t\treturn transfers[i].At < transfers[j].At\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn transfers[i].From < transfers[j].From\n\t})\n\tfor _, t := range transfers {\n\t\tt := t\n\t\teng.ScheduleAt(t.At, 0, func(now int64) {\n\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: now, Kind: EvScheduleTransfer, From: t.From, To: t.To, Amount: t.Amount})\n\t\t\tnodes[t.From].Transfer(t.To, t.Amount, now)\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\tsnaps := append([]SnapshotEvent(nil), r.Snapshots...)\n\tsort.SliceStable(snaps, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\tif snaps[i].At != snaps[j].At {\n\t\t\treturn snaps[i].At < snaps[j].At\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn snaps[i].ID < snaps[j].ID\n\t})\n\tfor _, s := range snaps {\n\t\ts := s\n\t\teng.ScheduleAt(s.At, 0, func(now int64) {\n\t\t\tok := mgr.Initiate(s.ID, s.Initiator, now)\n\t\t\tif ok {\n\t\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: now, Kind: EvInitiate, SnapID: s.ID,\n\t\t\t\t\tFrom: s.Initiator, Note: \"快照发起\"})\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\n\t// 持续随机流量：每个 tick 抽源/目的/金额，用的是引擎的可复现 RNG。\n\tif r.Traffic != nil {\n\t\ttc := r.Traffic\n\t\tvar scheduleTick func(at int64)\n\t\tscheduleTick = func(at int64) {\n\t\t\tif at > tc.Until {\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\teng.ScheduleAt(at, 0, func(now int64) {\n\t\t\t\tfrom := int(eng.RNG().Int63n(int64(n)))\n\t\t\t\tto := int(eng.RNG().Int63n(int64(n - 1)))\n\t\t\t\tif to >= from {\n\t\t\t\t\tto++\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tamount := int(eng.RNG().Int63n(int64(tc.MaxAmount))) + 1\n\t\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: now, Kind: EvScheduleTransfer, From: from, To: to, Amount: amount})\n\t\t\t\tnodes[from].Transfer(to, amount, now) // 余额不足时节点自身跳过\n\t\t\t\tscheduleTick(now + tc.Every)\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t}\n\t\tscheduleTick(tc.From)\n\t}\n\n\teng.Run()\n\n\t// 汇总快照结果。\n\tallSnapIDs := map[int]bool{}\n\tfor _, s := range r.Snapshots {\n\t\tallSnapIDs[s.ID] = true\n\t}\n\tfor _, id := range mgr.CompletedIDs() {\n\t\tallSnapIDs[id] = true\n\t}\n\tids := make([]int, 0, len(allSnapIDs))\n\tfor id := range allSnapIDs {\n\t\tids = append(ids, id)\n\t}\n\tsort.Ints(ids)\n\tresp := &Response{\n\t\tSeed:         r.Seed,\n\t\tNow:          eng.Now(),\n\t\tDeadline:     r.Deadline,\n\t\tInitialTotal: initialTotal,\n\t\tEvents:       events,\n\t}\n\tfor _, id := range ids {\n\t\ts := mgr.Build(id)\n\t\tres := SnapshotResult{Snapshot: s, Expected: initialTotal}\n\t\tfor _, ns := range s.Nodes {\n\t\t\tif st, ok := ns.State.(bank.State); ok {\n\t\t\t\tres.NodeSum += st.Balance\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor _, ch := range s.Channels {\n\t\t\tfor _, mm := range ch.Msgs {\n\t\t\t\tif !mm.IsReply {\n\t\t\t\t\tres.InFlight += mm.Amount\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tres.Total = res.NodeSum + res.InFlight\n\t\tres.Conserved = s.Complete && res.Total == initialTotal\n\t\tresp.Snapshots = append(resp.Snapshots, res)\n\t}\n\n\tfinalTotal := 0\n\tfor i, nd := range nodes {\n\t\tresp.FinalBalances = append(resp.FinalBalances, BalanceEntry{Node: i, Balance: nd.Balance()})\n\t\tfinalTotal += nd.Balance()\n\t}\n\tresp.FinalTotal = finalTotal\n\n\tfor a := 0; a < n; a++ {\n\t\tfor b := 0; b < n; b++ {\n\t\t\tif a == b {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tresp.Network = append(resp.Network, LinkStat{From: a, To: b, Stats: netw.Stats(a, b)})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif r.Deadline > 0 && eng.Pending() > 0 {\n\t\tresp.StoppedDeadline = true\n\t}\n\treturn resp\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_3d85da4bec6cce12573bb16c","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1032,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":47928,"output_tokens":3472,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_ayxynms1jqaob9zrywpt65qa":{"content":"package {\n\tAt       int64  `json:\"at\"`\n\tKind     string `json:\"kind\"`\n\tSnapID   int    `json:\"snap_id,omitempty\"`\n\tFrom     int    `json:\"from,omitempty\"`\n\tTo       int    `json:\"to,omitempty\"`\n\tAmount   int    `json:\"amount,omitempty\"`\n\tTxnID    int64  `json:\"txn_id,omitempty\"`\n\tIsReply  bool   `json:\"is_reply,omitempty\"`\n\tSendID   int    `json:\"send_id,omitempty\"`\n\tDup      bool   `json:\"dup,omitempty\"`\n\tNote     string `json:\"note,omitempty\"`\n\tBalances []int  `json:\"balances,omitempty\"` // 仅 snap_complete：完成时刻各节点余额\n}\n\n// SnapshotResult 是单次快照的结果。\ntype SnapshotResult struct {\n\tSnapshot snap.Snapshot `json:\"snapshot\"`\n\tNodeSum  int           `json:\"node_sum\"`             // 记录状态中余额之和\n\tInFlight int           `json:\"in_flight\"`            // 在途 REQ 金额之和\n\tTotal    int           `json:\"total\"`                // node_sum + in_flight\n\tExpected int           `json:\"expected\"`             // 初始总余额（守恒参照）\n\tConserved bool         `json:\"conserved\"`            // total == expected\n}\n\n// BalanceEntry 是结束时某节点余额。\ntype BalanceEntry struct {\n\tNode    int `json:\"node\"`\n\tBalance int `json:\"balance\"`\n}\n\n// LinkStat 是一条有向信道的结束统计。\ntype LinkStat struct {\n\tFrom int        `json:\"from\"`\n\tTo   int        `json:\"to\"`\n\tStats sim.Stats `json:\"stats\"`\n}\n\n// Response 是一次模拟运行的输出。\ntype Response struct {\n\tSeed            int64            `json:\"seed\"`\n\tNow             int64            `json:\"now\"`\n\tDeadline        int64            `json:\"deadline\"`\n\tInitialTotal    int              `json:\"initial_total\"`\n\tFinalBalances   []BalanceEntry   `json:\"final_balances\"`\n\tFinalTotal      int              `json:\"final_total\"`\n\tSnapshots       []SnapshotResult `json:\"snapshots\"`\n\tNetwork         []LinkStat       `json:\"network\"`\n\tEvents          []LogEvent       `json:\"events\"`\n\tStoppedDeadline bool             `json:\"stopped_by_deadline,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Run 执行请求并返回结果。请求必须已通过 Validate。\nfunc Run(r *Request) *Response {\n\tn := len(r.Balances)\n\teng := sim.NewEngine(r.Seed)\n\tif r.Deadline > 0 {\n\t\teng.SetDeadline(r.Deadline)\n\t}\n\tnetw := sim.NewNetwork(eng)\n\tpolicies, _ := r.Validate()\n\tfor a := 0; a < n; a++ {\n\t\tfor b := a + 1; b < n; b++ {\n\t\t\tnetw.AddLink(a, b, policies[pairKey(a, b)])\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tevents := []LogEvent{}\n\tlogf := func(e LogEvent) { events = append(events, e) }\n\n\tnodes := make([]*bank.Node, n)\n\tvar mgr *snap.Manager\n\tlogComplete := func(id int, at int64) {\n\t\tif mgr == nil || !mgr.IsComplete(id) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\t// 仅在“此前未完成”时记录一次。\n\t\tfor _, e := range events {\n\t\t\tif e.Kind == EvComplete && e.SnapID == id {\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tbs := make([]int, n)\n\t\tfor i, nd := range nodes {\n\t\t\tbs[i] = nd.Balance()\n\t\t}\n\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: at, Kind: EvComplete, SnapID: id, Balances: bs})\n\t}\n\n\tsend := func(m msg.Message) {\n\t\tnetw.Send(m, func(d sim.Delivery) {\n\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: d.At, Kind: EvDeliver, From: d.Msg.From, To: mgr.DataReceived(d.Msg.From, d.Msg.To, d.Msg)\n\t\t\tfor _, sid := range captured {\n\t\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: d.At, Kind: EvCaptured, SnapID: sid, From: d.Msg.From, To: d.Msg.To,\n\t\t\t\t\tAmount: d.Msg.Amount, TxnID: d.Msg.TxnID, IsReply: d.Msg.IsReply})\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tnodes[d.Msg.To].Receive(d.Msg, d.At, d.Dup)\n\t\t})\n\t\tkind := EvSend\n\t\tif m.IsMarker() {\n\t\t\tkind = EvMarkerSend\n\t\t}\n\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: eng.Now(), Kind: kind, SnapID: m.SnapID, From: m.From, To: m.To,\n\t\t\tAmount: m.Amount, TxnID: m.TxnID, IsReply: m.IsReply})\n\t}\n\tfor i := 0; i < n; i++ {\n\t\ti := i\n\t\tnodes[i] = bank.New(i, r.Balances[i], send, func(ev bank.Event) {\n\t\t\tif ev.Kind == \"insufficient\" {\n\t\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: ev.At, Kind: EvInsufficient, From: ev.Node, To: now)\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\tsnaps := append([]SnapshotEvent(nil), r.Snapshots...)\n\tsort.SliceStable(snaps, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\tif snaps[i].At != snaps[j].At {\n\t\t\treturn snaps[i].At < snaps[j].At\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn snaps[i].ID < snaps[j].ID\n\t})\n\tfor _, s := range snaps {\n\t\ts := s\n\t\teng.ScheduleAt(s.At, 0, func(now int64) {\n\t\t\tok := mgr.Initiate(s.ID, s.Initiator, now)\n\t\t\tif ok {\n\t\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: now, Kind: EvInitiate, SnapID: s.ID,\n\t\t\t\t\tFrom: s.Initiator, Note: \"快照发起\"})\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\n\t// 持续随机流量：每个 tick 抽源/目的/金额，用的是引擎的可复现 RNG。\n\tif r.Traffic != nil {\n\t\ttc := r.Traffic\n\t\tvar scheduleTick func(at int64)\n\t\tscheduleTick = func(at int64) {\n\t\t\tif at > tc.Until {\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\teng.ScheduleAt(at, 0, func(now int64) {\n\t\t\t\tfrom := int(eng.RNG().Int63n(int64(n)))\n\t\t\t\tto := int(eng.RNG().Int63n(int64(n - 1)))\n\t\t\t\tif to >= from {\n\t\t\t\t\tto++\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tamount := int(eng.RNG().Int63n(int64(tc.MaxAmount))) + 1\n\t\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: now, Kind: EvScheduleTransfer, From: from, To: to, Amount: amount})\n\t\t\t\tnodes[from].Transfer(to, amount, now) // 余额不足时节点自身跳过\n\t\t\t\tscheduleTick(now + tc.Every)\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t}\n\t\tscheduleTick(tc.From)\n\t}\n\n\teng.Run()\n\n\t// 汇总快照结果。\n\tallSnapIDs := map[int]bool{}\n\tfor _, s := range r.Snapshots {\n\t\tallSnapIDs[s.ID] = true\n\t}\n\tfor _, id := range mgr.CompletedIDs() {\n\t\tallSnapIDs[id] = true\n\t}\n\tids := FIFO：标记与业务消息走同一信道，标记不会越过业务消息；\n//   - 节点收到某快照的第一个标记时：记录自身状态，并沿所有出信道发送该快照标记；\n//   - 节点在“已记录状态”到“收到来自某邻居的标记”之间收到的业务消息，\n//     全部记入该入信道的在途消息；\n//\n// 多个快照 ID 可以同时交叠进行，彼此状态完全隔离。\npackage snap\n\nimport (\n\t\"sort\"\n\n\t\"simsnap/internal/msg\"\n)\n\n// MarkerSender 负责把快照标记真正送入网络（由应用层注入，避免本包依赖网络实现）。\ntype MarkerSender func(from, to, snapID int)\n\n// StateOf 返回节点当前待记录的状态（由应用层注入；可以是任意可序列化值）。\ntype StateOf func(node int) any\n\n// NodeState 是一个节点记录下来的本地状态。\ntype NodeState struct {\n\tNode    int   `json:\"node\"`\n\tState   any   `json:\"state\"`\n\tTakenAt int64 `json:\"taken_at\"`\n}\n\n// ChannelState 是一条有向信道在快照中的记录。\ntype ChannelState struct {\n\tFrom  int          `json:\"from\"`\n\tTo    int          `json:\"to\"`\n\tMsgs  []msg.Message `json:\"msgs\"` // 在途消息（含发送时刻）\n\tClosed bool        `json:\"closed\"`\n}\n\n// Snapshot 是一次全局快照（可能尚未完成）。\ntype Snapshot struct {\n\tID         int            `json:\"id\"`\n\tComplete   bool           `json:\"complete\"`\n\tCompleteAt int64          `json:\"complete_at,omitempty\"`\n\tNodes      []NodeState    `json:\"nodes\"`    // 已记录状态的节点（按节点号排序）\n\tChannels   []ChannelState `json:\"channels\"` // 全部有向信道（按 from,to 排序）\n\tMissingNodes    []int     `json:\"missing_nodes,omitempty\"`\n\tOpenChannels    [][2]int  `json:\"open_channels,omitempty\"` // 尚未收到标记的入信道\n}\n\ntype chanRec struct {\n\tmsgs   []msg.Message\n\tclosed bool\n}\n\ntype nodeRec struct {\n\tdone    bool\n\tstate   any\n\ttakenAt int64\n\tin      map[int]*chanRec // in[from] = 信道 from->本节点 的记录\n}\n\ntype snapState struct {\n\tid      int\n\tnodes   map[int]*nodeRec\n\tcomplete   bool\n\tcompleteAt int64\n}\n\n// Manager 管理若干个交叠进行的快照，所有方法仅在单线程事件循环中调用。\ntype Manager struct {\n\tn          int\n\tsnaps      map[int]*snapState\n\tsendMarker MarkerSender\n\tstateOf    StateOf\n}\n\n// NewManager 创建快照管理器。n 为节点数（节点编号 0..n-1，全互联拓扑）。\nfunc NewManager(n int, sendMarker MarkerSender, stateOf StateOf) *Manager {\n\treturn &Manager{n: n, snaps: map[int]*snapState{}, sendMarker: sendMarker, stateOf: stateOf}\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) getOrCreate(id int) *snapState {\n\ts := m.snaps[id]\n\tif s == nil {\n\t\t// 标记可能先于“本地发起”事件到达（发起节点在别处），惰性建立记录。\n\t\ts = &snapState{id: id, nodes: map[int]*nodeRec{}}\n\t\tm.snaps[id] = s\n\t}\n\treturn s\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) nodeRec(s *snapState, node int) *nodeRec {\n\tr := s.nodes[node]\n\tif r == nil {\n\t\tr = &nodeRec{in: map[int]*chanRec{}}\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif j != node {\n\t\t\t\tr.in[j] = &chanRec{}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\ts.nodes[node] = r\n\t}\n\treturn r\n}\n\n// Initiate 由发起节点启动一次快照（幂等：重复 ID 不会重入）。返回 false 表示该 ID 已存在。\nfunc (m *Manager) Initiate(id int, initiator int, at int64) bool {\n\tif _, ok := m.snaps[id]; ok {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\ts := m.getOrCreate(id)\n\tm.recordState(s, initiator, at)\n\t// 记录状态后，沿所有出信道发送标记。\n\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\tif j != initiator {\n\t\t\tm.sendMarker(initiator, j, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) recordState(s *snapState, node int, at int64) {\n\tr := m.nodeRec(s, node)\n\tif r.done {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tr.done = true\n\tr.state = m.stateOf(node)\n\tr.takenAt = at\n}\n\n// MarkerReceived 处理 node 收到来自 from 的快照标记。\nfunc (m *Manager) MarkerReceived(id, from, node int, at int64) {\n\ts := m.getOrCreate(id)\n\tr := m.nodeRec(s, node)\n\tfirst := !r.done\n\tif first {\n\t\t// 规则：收到第一个标记的瞬间记录本地状态，再向所有出信道转发标记。\n\t\tm.recordState(s, node, at)\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif j != node {\n\t\t\t\tm.sendMarker(node, j, id)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// 规则：收到标记 => 该入信道在途消息记录截止。\n\tif ch := r.in[from]; ch != nil {\n\t\tch.closed = true\n\t}\n\tm.checkComplete(s, at)\n}\n\n// DataReceived 在 node 处理一条业务消息【之前】调用：\n// 若 node 已为某快照记录状态、且来自 from 的信道尚未关闭，则该消息属于该快照的在途消息。\n// 返回该消息被哪些快照捕获。\nfunc (m *Manager) DataReceived(from, node int, message msg.Message) []int {\n\tvar captured []int\n\tfor _, id := m.activeIDs(node) {\n\t\ts := m.snaps[id]\n\t\tr := s.nodes[node]\n\t\tch := r.in[from]\n\t\tif ch != nil && !ch.closed {\n\t\t\tch.msgs = append(ch.msgs, message)\n\t\t\tcaptured = append(captured, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn captured\n}\n\n// activeIDs 返回 node 已记录状态、但全局尚未完成的快照 ID（升序，保证确定性）。\nfunc (m *Manager) activeIDs(node int) []int {\n\tids := make([]int, 0)\n\tfor id, s := range m.snaps {\n\t\tif s.complete {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r := s.nodes[node]; r != nil && r.done {\n\t\t\tids = append(ids, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Ints(ids)\n\treturn ids\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) checkComplete(s *snapState, at int64) {\n\tif s.complete {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif len(s.nodes) != m.n {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tfor i := 0; i < m.n; i++ {\n\t\tr := s.nodes[i]\n\t\tif r == nil || !r.done {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif j == i {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tch := r.in[j]\n\t\t\tif ch == nil || !ch.closed {\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\ts.complete = true\n\ts.completeAt = at\n}\n\n// IsComplete 报告某快照是否已完成。\nfunc (m *Manager) IsComplete(id int) bool {\n\tif s := m.snaps[id]; s != nil {\n\t\treturn s.complete\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// CompletedIDs 返回所有已完成快照 ID（升序）。\nfunc (m *Manager) CompletedIDs() []int {\n\tvar ids []int\n\tfor id, s := range m.snaps {\n\t\tif s.complete {\n\t\t\tids = append(ids, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Ints(ids)\n\treturn ids\n}\n\n// Build 生成某快照的可序列化报告（无论是否完成都可调用）。\nfunc (m *Manager) Build(id int) Snapshot {\n\ts := m.snaps[id]\n\tout := Snapshot{ID: id}\n\tif s == nil {\n\t\treturn out\n\t}\n\tout.Complete = s.complete\n\tout.CompleteAt = s.completeAt\n\n\tnodeIDs := make([]int, 0, len(s.nodes))\n\tfor i := range s.nodes {\n\t\tnodeIDs = append(nodeIDs, i)\n\t}\n\tsort.Ints(nodeIDs)\n\tfor _, i := range nodeIDs {\n\t\tr := s.nodes[i]\n\t\tif r.done {\n\t\t\tout.Nodes = append(out.Nodes, NodeState{Node: i, State: r.state, TakenAt: r.takenAt})\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tout.MissingNodes = append(out.MissingNodes, i)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Ints(out.MissingNodes)\n\n\tfor a := 0; a < m.n; a++ {\n\t\tfor b := 0; b < m.n; b++ {\n\t\t\tif a == b {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tcs := ChannelState{From: a, To: b}\n\t\t\tif r := s.nodes[b]; r != nil {\n\t\t\t\tif ch := r.in[a]; ch != nil {\n\t\t\t\t\tcs.Closed = ch.closed\n\t\t\t\t\tcs.Msgs = append(cs.Msgs, ch.msgs...)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif !cs.Closed {\n\t\t\t\tout.OpenChannels = append(out.OpenChannels, [2]int{a, b})\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tout.Channels = append(out.Channels, cs)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":155,"oldLines":7,"newStart":155,"newLines":7,"lines":[" // 返回该消息被哪些快照捕获。"," func (m *Manager) DataReceived(from, {"type":"last-prompt","lastPrompt":"从空目录开发“分片屏障快照”纯后端项目。用Go实现确定性离散事件模拟器与JSON运行接口，节点在单进程内模拟，网络可丢包、重复和乱序，禁止依赖真实集群。实现Chandy-Lamport快照，限定可靠FIFO信道，记录节点状态与在途消息；允许多个快照ID交叠而不串台。验收：用转账守恒模型验证快照总量，覆盖空信道、标记交错和快照期间持续消息发送。交付源码、README、请求样例与自动化测试；实际运行并…","leafUuid":"4dd4420e-149d-4d8b-a1fc-eb83b51c0015","sessionId":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0"}

Package snap 实现 Chandy–Lamport 分布式快照算法。\n//\n// 前提（见论文条件）：\n//   - 信道可靠且 FIFO：标记与业务消息走同一信道，标记不会越过业务消息；\n//   - 节点收到某快照的第一个标记时：记录自身状态，并沿所有出信道发送该快照标记；\n//   - 节点在“已记录状态”到“收到来自某邻居的标记”之间收到的业务消息，\n//     全部记入该入信道的在途消息；\n//\n// 多个快照 ID 可以同时交叠进行，彼此状态完全隔离。\npackage snap\n\nimport (\n\t\"sort\"\n\n\t\"simsnap/internal/msg\"\n)\n\n// MarkerSender 负责把快照标记真正送入网络（由应用层注入，避免本包依赖网络实现）。\ntype MarkerSender func(from, to, snapID int)\n\n// StateOf 返回节点当前待记录的状态（由应用层注入；可以是任意可序列化值）。\ntype StateOf func(node int) any\n\n// NodeState 是一个节点记录下来的本地状态。\ntype NodeState struct {\n\tNode    int   `json:\"node\"`\n\tState   any   `json:\"state\"`\n\tTakenAt int64 `json:\"taken_at\"`\n}\n\n// ChannelState 是一条有向信道在快照中的记录。\ntype ChannelState struct {\n\tFrom   int           `json:\"from\"`\n\tTo     int           `json:\"to\"`\n\tMsgs   []msg.Message `json:\"msgs\"`\n\tClosed bool          `json:\"closed\"`\n}\n\n// Snapshot 是一次全局快照（可能尚未完成）。\ntype Snapshot struct {\n\tID             int            `json:\"id\"`\n\tComplete       bool           `json:\"complete\"`\n\tCompleteAt     int64          `json:\"complete_at,omitempty\"`\n\tNodes          []NodeState    `json:\"nodes\"`        // 已记录状态的节点（按节点号排序）\n\tChannels       []ChannelState `json:\"channels\"`     // 在记录窗口内捕到过消息的入信道（按 to,from 排序）\n\tMissingNodes   []int          `json:\"missing_nodes,omitempty\"`\n\tOpenChannels   [][2]int       `json:\"open_channels,omitempty\"` // 尚未关闭的入信道\n}\n\ntype chanRec struct {\n\tmsgs   []msg.Message\n\tclosed bool\n}\n\ntype nodeRec struct {\n\tdone    bool\n\tstate   any\n\ttakenAt int64\n\tin      map[int]*chanRec // in[peer] = 信道 peer->本节点 的记录\n}\n\ntype snapState struct {\n\tid         int\n\tnodes      map[int]*nodeRec\n\tcomplete   bool\n\tcompleteAt int64\n}\n\n// Manager 管理若干个交叠进行的快照，所有方法仅在单线程事件循环中调用。\ntype Manager struct {\n\tn          int\n\tsnaps      map[int]*snapState\n\tsendMarker MarkerSender\n\tstateOf    StateOf\n}\n\n// NewManager 创建快照管理器。n 为节点数（节点编号 0..n-1，全互联拓扑）。\nfunc NewManager(n int, sendMarker MarkerSender, stateOf StateOf) *Manager {\n\treturn &Manager{n: n, snaps: map[int]*snapState{}, sendMarker: sendMarker, stateOf: stateOf}\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) getOrCreate(id int) *snapState {\n\ts := m.snaps[id]\n\tif s == nil {\n\t\t// 标记可能先于“本地发起”事件到达（发起节点在别处），惰性建立记录。\n\t\ts = &snapState{id: id, nodes: map[int]*nodeRec{}}\n\t\tm.snaps[id] = s\n\t}\n\treturn s\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) nodeRec(s *snapState, node int) *nodeRec {\n\tr := s.nodes[node]\n\tif r == nil {\n\t\tr = &nodeRec{in: map[int]*chanRec{}}\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif j != node {\n\t\t\t\tr.in[j] = &chanRec{}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\ts.nodes[node] = r\n\t}\n\treturn r\n}\n\n// Initiate 由发起节点启动一次快照（幂等：重复 ID 不会重入）。返回 false 表示该 ID 已存在。\nfunc (m *Manager) Initiate(id int, initiator int, at int64) bool {\n\tif _, ok := m.snaps[id]; ok {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\ts := m.getOrCreate(id)\n\tm.recordState(s, initiator, at)\n\t// 记录状态后，沿所有出信道发送标记。\n\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\tif j != initiator {\n\t\t\tm.sendMarker(initiator, j, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) recordState(s *snapState, node int, at int64) {\n\tr := m.nodeRec(s, node)\n\tif r.done {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tr.done = true\n\tr.state = m.stateOf(node)\n\tr.takenAt = at\n}\n\n// MarkerReceived 处理 node 收到来自 from 的快照标记。\nfunc (m *Manager) MarkerReceived(id, from, node int, at int64) {\n\ts := m.getOrCreate(id)\n\tr := m.nodeRec(s, node)\n\tfirst := !r.done\n\tif first {\n\t\t// 规则：收到第一个标记的瞬间记录本地状态，再向所有出信道转发标记。\n\t\tm.recordState(s, node, at)\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif j != node {\n\t\t\t\tm.sendMarker(node, j, id)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// 规则：收到标记 => 入信道 from->node 的在途消息记录截止。\n\tif ch := r.in[from]; ch != nil {\n\t\tch.closed = true\n\t}\n\tm.checkComplete(s, at)\n}\n\n// DataReceived 在 node 处理一条业务消息【之前】调用：\n// 若 node 已为某快照记录状态、且来自 from 的信道尚未关闭，则该消息属于该快照的在途消息。\n// 返回该消息被哪些快照捕获（升序，保证确定性）。\nfunc (m *Manager) DataReceived(from, node int, message msg.Message) []int {\n\tvar captured []int\n\tfor _, id := range m.activeIDs(node) {\n\t\ts := m.snaps[id]\n\t\tr := s.nodes[node]\n\t\tch := r.in[from] // in 的键是对端节点；from 即入信道的发送方\n\t\tif ch != nil && !ch.closed {\n\t\t\tch.msgs = append(ch.msgs, message)\n\t\t\tcaptured = append(captured, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn captured\n}\n\n// activeIDs 返回 node 已记录状态、但全局尚未完成的快照 ID（升序，保证确定性）。\nfunc (m *Manager) activeIDs(node int) []int {\n\tids := make([]int, 0)\n\tfor id, s := range m.snaps {\n\t\tif s.complete {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r := s.nodes[node]; r != nil && r.done {\n\t\t\tids = append(ids, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Ints(ids)\n\treturn ids\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) checkComplete(s *snapState, at int64) {\n\tif s.complete {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif len(s.nodes) != m.n {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tfor i := 0; i < m.n; i++ {\n\t\tr := s.nodes[i]\n\t\tif r == nil || !r.done {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif j == i {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif ch := r.in[j]; ch == nil || !ch.closed {\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\ts.complete = true\n\ts.completeAt = at\n}\n\n// IsComplete 报告某快照是否已完成。\nfunc (m *Manager) IsComplete(id int) bool {\n\tif s := m.snaps[id]; s != nil {\n\t\treturn s.complete\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// CompletedIDs 返回所有已完成快照 ID（升序）。\nfunc (m *Manager) CompletedIDs() []int {\n\tvar ids []int\n\tfor id, s := range m.snaps {\n\t\tif s.complete {\n\t\t\tids = append(ids, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Ints(ids)\n\treturn ids\n}\n\n// Build 生成某快照的可序列化报告（无论是否完成都可调用）。\n// 只输出在记录窗口内捕到过消息的信道；空信道隐含“无在途消息”，避免 N×N 的零值噪声。\nfunc (m *Manager) Build(id int) Snapshot {\n\ts := m.snaps[id]\n\tout := Snapshot{ID: id}\n\tif s == nil {\n\t\treturn out\n\t}\n\tout.Complete = s.complete\n\tout.CompleteAt = s.completeAt\n\n\tnodeIDs := make([]int, 0, len(s.nodes))\n\tfor i := range s.nodes {\n\t\tnodeIDs = append(nodeIDs, i)\n\t}\n\tsort.Ints(nodeIDs)\n\tfor _, i := range nodeIDs {\n\t\tr := s.nodes[i]\n\t\tif r.done {\n\t\t\tout.Nodes = append(out.Nodes, NodeState{Node: i, State: r.state, TakenAt: r.takenAt})\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tout.MissingNodes = append(out.MissingNodes, i)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Ints(out.MissingNodes)\n\n\tfor b := 0; b < m.n; b++ {\n\t\tr := s.nodes[b]\n\t\tif r == nil {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tpeers := make([]int, 0, len(r.in))\n\t\tfor a := range r.in {\n\t\t\tpeers = append(peers, a)\n\t\t}\n\t\tsort.Ints(peers)\n\t\tfor _, a := range peers {\n\t\t\tch := r.in[a]\n\t\t\tif len(ch.msgs) == 0 {\n\t\t\t\tif !ch.closed {\n\t\t\t\t\tout.OpenChannels = append(out.OpenChannels, [2]int{a, b})\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tcs := ChannelState{From: a, To: b, Closed: ch.closed, Msgs: append([]msg.Message(nil), ch.msgs...)}\n\t\t\tif !ch.closed {\n\t\t\t\tout.OpenChannels = append(out.OpenChannels, [2]int{a, b})\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tout.Channels = append(out.Channels, cs)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_4c23178e081d42ca80ba131f","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1494,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":57144,"output_tokens":2801,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_q6mjxhs7wdx5vm1l3gld3vi1":{"content":"// int          `json:\"from\"`\n\tTo    int          `json:\"to\"`\n\tMsgs  []msg.Message `json:\"msgs\"` // 在途消息（含发送时刻）\n\tClosed bool        `json:\"closed\"`\n}\n\n// Snapshot 是一次全局快照（可能尚未完成）。\ntype {"parentUuid":"98620f62-7600-43b8-8281-6930f0a20dea","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"text":"发现模型层面的关键问题：两阶段“先扣款+ACK”协议下，ACK 在收款方记录状态**之前**发出时既不在状态里也不在任何在途信道里（经典 CL 只保证单向消息的 cut 一致，ACK 会造成漏算）。经典 CL 银行模型是**单向转账消息、收到即入账**，守恒式才是干净的「状态余额和 + 在途 REQ」。简化协议（重复网络仍靠 TxnID 幂等）：\n","type":"text"}],"id":"msg_242d726d3b849382a43eb056","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1183,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":62264,"output_tokens":1710,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"apiBlockIndex":1,"type":"assistant","uuid":"47c8fef0-830a-440d-a6d7-ad7cbdf65202","timestamp":"2026-09-23T05:54:38.373Z","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp30/b","sessionId":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp30-b","slug":"glimmering-hopping-papert"}
{"parentUuid":"47c8fef0-830a-440d-a6d7-ad7cbdf65202","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_mcyc98b31rw6729e26ngf8z8","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp30/b/internal/bank/node.go","content":"// Package bank 实现“转账守恒模型”的节点：每个节点持有一个余额，\n// 转账是单向消息——发起方先本地扣款，收款方收到即入账。\n//\n// 这正是 Chandy–Lamport 原论文使用的银行模型：\n// 任意时刻恒有  所有节点余额之和 + 所有在途转账金额之和 = 初始总额。\n//\n// 幂等：网络可能重复投递，收款方按 TxnID 去重，重复副本不会重复入账。\n// 丢包（非可靠信道）会让资金停留在“已扣未入”状态，最终余额和变小——\n// 这也从反面说明可靠信道是 Chandy–Lamport 快照能够终止、守恒成立的前提。\npackage bank\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n)\n\n// State 是快照记录的节点可序列化状态。\ntype State struct {\n\tBalance int `json:\"balance\"`\n}\n\n// Event 是节点视角的业务日志条目（供输出与测试观察）。\ntype Event struct {\n\tAt      int64  `json:\"at\"`\n\tNode    int    `json:\"node\"`\n\tKind    string `json:\"kind\"` // send / recv / drop_dup / insufficient\n\tPeer    int    `json:\"peer\"`\n\tAmount  int    `json:\"amount,omitempty\"`\n\tTxnID   int64  `json:\"txn_id,omitempty\"`\n\tBalance int    `json:\"balance\"`\n\tNote    string `json:\"note,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Sender 把一条转账消息送入网络（由 wiring 层注入网络 + 日志）。\ntype Sender func(to, amount int, txn int64)\n\n// Node 是一个银行网点节点。\ntype Node struct {\n\tid      int\n\tbalance int\n\ttxnSeq  int64\n\tseenTxn map[int64]bool // 已入账的事务号（重复投递幂等）\n\tsend    Sender\n\tlog     func(Event)\n}\n\n// New 创建节点。\nfunc New(id, balance int, send Sender, log func(Event)) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{\n\t\tid:      id,\n\t\tbalance: balance,\n\t\tseenTxn: map[int64]bool{},\n\t\tsend:    send,\n\t\tlog:     log,\n\t}\n}\n\n// ID 返回节点编号。\nfunc (n *Node) ID() int { return n.id }\n\n// Balance 返回当前余额。\nfunc (n *Node) Balance() int { return n.balance }\n\n// SnapshotState 返回快照用的节点状态。\nfunc (n *Node) SnapshotState() any { return State{Balance: n.balance} }\n\n// Transfer 发起一笔向 to 的转账。余额不足返回 false 且不产生任何副作用。\nfunc (n *Node) Transfer(to, amount int, at int64) bool {\n\tif amount <= 0 {\n\t\tpanic(fmt.Sprintf(\"bank: 转账金额必须为正: %d\", amount))\n\t}\n\tif amount > n.balance {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"insufficient\", Peer: to, Amount: amount, Balance: n.balance})\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tn.txnSeq++\n\ttxn := n.txnSeq\n\tn.balance -= amount\n\tn.send(to, amount, txn)\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"send\", Peer: to, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn, Balance: n.balance})\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// Receive 处理一条投递到本节点的转账：金额 amount，事务号 txn，dup 表示网络重复副本。\nfunc (n *Node) Receive(from int, amount int, txn int64, at int64, dup bool) {\n\tif n.seenTxn[txn] {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"drop_dup\", Peer: from, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn, Balance: n.balance,\n\t\t\tNote: \"重复转账，已忽略\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tn.seenTxn[txn] = true\n\tn.balance += amount\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"recv\", Peer: from, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn, Balance: n.balance})\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_242d726d3b849382a43eb056","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1183,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":62264,"output_tokens":1710,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_mcyc98b31rw6729e26ngf8z8":{"content":"// 应答”两阶段消息转移金额。\n//\n// 协议：\n//   - 发起转账：发起方先本地扣款，再向收款方发 REQ；\n//   - REQ 幂等（重复投递不会重复入账，TxnID 去重）；收款方入账后回 ACK；\n//   - ACK 幂等。资金始终只在“已扣未入”的在途状态，全系统总额守恒。\npackage bank\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\n\t\"simsnap/internal/msg\"\n)\n\n// State 是快照记录的节点可序列化状态。\ntype State struct {\n\tBalance int `json:\"balance\"`\n}\n\n// Event 是节点视角的业务日志条目（供输出与测试观察）。\ntype Event struct {\n\tAt      int64 `json:\"at\"`\n\tNode    int   `json:\"node\"`\n\tKind    string `json:\"kind\"`     // send_req / recv_req / recv_ack / drop_dup / insufficient\n\tPeer    int   `json:\"peer\"`\n\tAmount  int   `json:\"amount,omitempty\"`\n\tTxnID   int64 `json:\"txn_id,omitempty\"`\n\tBalance int   `json:\"balance\"`\n\tNote    string `json:\"note,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Sender 把一条业务消息送入网络（由 wiring 层注入网络 + 日志）。\ntype Sender func(m msg.Message)\n\n// Node 是一个银行网点节点。\ntype Node struct {\n\tid      int\n\tbalance int\n\ttxnSeq  int64\n\tseenReq map[int64]bool // 已入账的 REQ 事务号\n\tseenAck map[int64]bool // 已处理的 ACK 事务号\n\tsend    Sender\n\tlog     func(Event)\n}\n\n// New 创建节点。\nfunc New(id, balance int, send Sender, log func(Event)) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{\n\t\tid:      id,\n\t\tbalance: balance,\n\t\tseenReq: map[int64]bool{},\n\t\tseenAck: map[int64]bool{},\n\t\tsend:    send,\n\t\tlog:     log,\n\t}\n}\n\n// ID 返回节点编号。\nfunc (n *Node) ID() int { return n.id }\n\n// Balance 返回当前余额。\nfunc (n *Node) Balance() int { return n.balance }\n\n// SnapshotState 返回快照用的节点状态。\nfunc (n *Node) SnapshotState() any { return State{Balance: n.balance} }\n\n// Transfer 发起一笔向 to 的转账。余额不足返回 false 且不产生任何副作用。\nfunc (n *Node) Transfer(to, amount int, at int64) bool {\n\tif amount <= 0 {\n\t\tpanic(fmt.Sprintf(\"bank: 转账金额必须为正: %d\", amount))\n\t}\n\tif amount > n.balance {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"insufficient\", Peer: to, Amount: amount, Balance: n.balance})\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tn.txnSeq++\n\ttxn := n.txnSeq\n\tn.balance -= amount\n\tn.send(msg.Message{Kind: msg.Data, From: n.id, To: to, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn})\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"send_req\", Peer: to, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn, Balance: n.balance})\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// Receive 处理一条投递到本节点的业务消息。dup 表示这是网络重复副本。\nfunc (n *Node) Receive(m msg.Message, at int64, dup bool) {\n\tif m.To != n.id {\n\t\tpanic(fmt.Sprintf(\"bank: 消息投递给错误的节点 %d（目标 %d）\", n.id, m.To))\n\t}\n\tif !m.IsReply {\n\t\t// REQ：重复事务直接丢弃，不重复入账。\n\t\tif n.seenReq[m.TxnID] {\n\t\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"drop_dup\", Peer: m.From, Amount: m.Amount, TxnID: m.TxnID, Balance: n.balance,\n\t\t\t\tNote: \"重复转账请求，已忽略\"})\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.seenReq[m.TxnID] = true\n\t\tn.balance += m.Amount\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"recv_req\", Peer: m.From, Amount: m.Amount, TxnID: m.TxnID, Balance: n.balance})\n\t\tack := m\n\t\tack.IsReply = true\n\t\tack.From, ack.To = n.id, m.From\n\t\tn.send(ack)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// ACK：重复副本幂等忽略。\n\tif n.seenAck[m.TxnID] {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"drop_dup\", Peer: m.From, Amount: m.Amount, TxnID: m.TxnID, Balance: n.balance,\n\t\t\tNote: \"重复应答，已忽略\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tn.seenAck[m.TxnID] = true\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"recv_ack\", Peer: m.From, Amount: m.Amount, TxnID: m.TxnID, Balance: n.balance})\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"46aa15d0-c9ca-4faf-861c-dff3474f2f2c","session_id":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp30/b","sessionId":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp30-b","slug":"glimmering-hopping-papert"}

{"parentUuid":"19d41dba-a965-4447-aeb4-cd32bd288f0f","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_gm2fwf5u1w1yxf8mgma7dxkf","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp30/b/internal/app/run.go","content":"package app\n\nimport (\n\t\"sort\"\n\n\t\"simsnap/internal/bank\"\n\t\"simsnap/internal/msg\"\n\t\"simsnap/internal/sim\"\n\t\"simsnap/internal/snap\"\n)\n\n// EventKind 枚举输出日志中的事件类型。\nconst (\n\tEvScheduleTransfer = \"schedule_transfer\"\n\tEvInsufficient     = \"insufficient\"\n\tEvSend             = \"send\"\n\tEvDeliver          = \"deliver\"\n\tEvMarkerSend       = \"marker_send\"\n\tEvMarkerDeliver    = \"marker_deliver\"\n\tEvCaptured         = \"snap_captured\"\n\tEvDropDup          = \"drop_dup\"\n\tEvInitiate         = \"snap_initiate\"\n\tEvComplete         = \"snap_complete\"\n)\n\n// LogEvent 是时间线日志条目。\ntype LogEvent struct {\n\tAt       int64  `json:\"at\"`\n\tKind     string `json:\"kind\"`\n\tSnapID   int    `json:\"snap_id,omitempty\"`\n\tFrom     int    `json:\"from,omitempty\"`\n\tTo       int    `json:\"to,omitempty\"`\n\tAmount   int    `json:\"amount,omitempty\"`\n\tTxnID    int64  `json:\"txn_id,omitempty\"`\n\tSendID   int    `json:\"send_id,omitempty\"`\n\tDup      bool   `json:\"dup,omitempty\"`\n\tNote     string `json:\"note,omitempty\"`\n\tBalances []int  `json:\"balances,omitempty\"` // 仅 snap_complete：完成时刻各节点余额\n}\n\n// SnapshotResult 是单次快照的结果。\ntype SnapshotResult struct {\n\tSnapshot snap.Snapshot `json:\"snapshot\"`\n\tNodeSum  int           `json:\"node_sum\"`  // 记录状态中余额之和\n\tInFlight int           `json:\"in_flight\"` // 在途转账金额之和\n\tTotal    int           `json:\"total\"`     // node_sum + in_flight\n\tExpected int           `json:\"expected\"`  // 初始总余额（守恒参照）\n\tConserved bool         `json:\"conserved\"` // complete && total == expected\n}\n\n// BalanceEntry 是结束时某节点余额。\ntype BalanceEntry struct {\n\tNode    int `json:\"node\"`\n\tBalance int `json:\"balance\"`\n}\n\n// LinkStat 是一条有向信道的结束统计。\ntype LinkStat struct {\n\tFrom  int       `json:\"from\"`\n\tTo    int       `json:\"to\"`\n\tStats sim.Stats `json:\"stats\"`\n}\n\n// Response 是一次模拟运行的输出。\ntype Response struct {\n\tSeed            int64            `json:\"seed\"`\n\tNow             int64            `json:\"now\"`\n\tDeadline        int64            `json:\"deadline\"`\n\tInitialTotal    int              `json:\"initial_total\"`\n\tFinalBalances   []BalanceEntry   `json:\"final_balances\"`\n\tFinalTotal      int              `json:\"final_total\"`\n\tSnapshots       []SnapshotResult `json:\"snapshots\"`\n\tNetwork         []LinkStat       `json:\"network\"`\n\tEvents          []LogEvent       `json:\"events\"`\n\tStoppedDeadline bool             `json:\"stopped_by_deadline,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Run 执行请求并返回结果。请求必须已通过 Validate。\nfunc Run(r *Request) *Response {\n\tn := len(r.Balances)\n\teng := sim.NewEngine(r.Seed)\n\tif r.Deadline > 0 {\n\t\teng.SetDeadline(r.Deadline)\n\t}\n\tnetw := sim.NewNetwork(eng)\n\tpolicies, _ := r.Validate()\n\tfor a := 0; a < n; a++ {\n\t\tfor b := a + 1; b < n; b++ {\n\t\t\tnetw.AddLink(a, b, policies[pairKey(a, b)])\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tevents := []LogEvent{}\n\tlogf := func(e LogEvent) { events = append(events, e) }\n\n\tnodes := make([]*bank.Node, n)\n\tvar mgr *snap.Manager\n\tlogComplete := func(id int, at int64) {\n\t\tif mgr == nil || !mgr.IsComplete(id) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor _, e := range events {\n\t\t\tif e.Kind == EvComplete && e.SnapID == id {\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tbs := make([]int, n)\n\t\tfor i, nd := range nodes {\n\t\t\tbs[i] = nd.Balance()\n\t\t}\n\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: at, Kind: EvComplete, SnapID: id, Balances: bs})\n\t}\n\n\tvar send func(m msg.Message)\n\tsend = func(m msg.Message) {\n\t\tnetw.Send(m, func(d sim.Delivery) {\n\t\t\tmm := d.Msg\n\t\t\tif mm.IsMarker() {\n\t\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: d.At, Kind: EvMarkerDeliver, SnapID: mm.SnapID,\n\t\t\t\t\tFrom: mm.From, To: mm.To, SendID: d.SendID, Dup: d.Dup})\n\t\t\t\tmgr.MarkerReceived(mm.SnapID, mm.From, mm.To, d.At)\n\t\t\t\tlogComplete(mm.SnapID, d.At)\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: d.At, Kind: EvDeliver, From: mm.From, To: mm.To,\n\t\t\t\tAmount: mm.Amount, TxnID: mm.TxnID, SendID: d.SendID, Dup: d.Dup})\n\t\t\t// Chandy–Lamport：先让快照管理器判定在途归属，再执行业务状态变更。\n\t\t\tcaptured := mgr.DataReceived(mm.From, mm.To, mm)\n\t\t\tfor _, sid := range captured {\n\t\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: d.At, Kind: EvCaptured, SnapID: sid, From: mm.From, To: mm.To,\n\t\t\t\t\tAmount: mm.Amount, TxnID: mm.TxnID})\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tnodes[mm.To].Receive(mm.From, mm.Amount, mm.TxnID, d.At, d.Dup)\n\t\t})\n\t\tkind := EvSend\n\t\tif m.IsMarker() {\n\t\t\tkind = EvMarkerSend\n\t\t}\n\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: eng.Now(), Kind: kind, SnapID: m.SnapID, From: m.From, To: m.To,\n\t\t\tAmount: m.Amount, TxnID: m.TxnID})\n\t}\n\tfor i := 0; i < n; i++ {\n\t\ti := i\n\t\tnodes[i] = bank.New(i, r.Balances[i],\n\t\t\tfunc(to, amount int, txn int64) {\n\t\t\t\tsend(msg.Message{Kind: msg.Data, {"parentUuid":"36c7a494-deb1-4889-a63f-88747445a80e","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"text":"根因更深：经典 CL 的银行模型里，“发起转账”不是立即扣款，而是**先记一笔待付（outgoing），把钱留到 cut 之后处理出信道时才扣**。立即扣款会让“记录状态前已发出、记录后才到达”的钱两边都不落账。重写为原论文语义：\n","type":"text"}],"id":"msg_cdf366b8f7abf5e1a7a98240","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1085,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":70456,"output_tokens":1821,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"apiBlockIndex":1,"type":"assistant","uuid":"0a711aa5-dcd3-4889-844f-20fcce1d06ea","timestamp":"2026-09-23T05:57:53.516Z","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp30/b","sessionId":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp30-b","slug":"glimmering-hopping-papert"}
{"parentUuid":"0a711aa5-dcd3-4889-844f-20fcce1d06ea","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_qdq10wj5knmqy66kt2tsnvnk","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp30/b/internal/bank/node.go","content":"// Package bank 实现 Chandy–Lamport 原论文中的“转账守恒模型”节点。\n//\n// 资金守恒（关键设计）：\n//\n//\t所有节点 balance 之和 + 所有在途转账金额之和 = 初始总额（无丢包时）\n//\n// 为保证上式与全局状态快照相容，发起转账时不立即扣款，而是登记一笔待付 pending：\n// 钱仍在发起方 balance 中；待付额在“本节点记录状态之后、沿该出信道的标记之后”\n// 才真正划出（这正是 CL 算法对“记录状态时在途中的本节点发出消息”的处理位置）。\n//\n// 因此节点持久状态是 {balance, pending[peer]}；\n// 收款方收到转账即入账；重复投递按 TxnID 幂等去重。\n// 丢包（非可靠信道）会使待付永远无法划出，资金停在发起方余额里，总额仍守恒，\n// 但快照无法完成（标记收不全）——从反面说明可靠信道是 CL 快照终止的前提。\npackage bank\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n)\n\n// State 是快照记录的节点可序列化状态。\ntype State struct {\n\tBalance int            `json:\"balance\"`\n\tPending map[string]int `json:\"pending\"` // 待付金额，键为对端节点号\n}\n\n// Event 是节点视角的业务日志条目（供输出与测试观察）。\ntype Event struct {\n\tAt      int64  `json:\"at\"`\n\tNode    int    `json:\"node\"`\n\tKind    string `json:\"kind\"` // send / recv / settle / drop_dup / insufficient\n\tPeer    int    `json:\"peer\"`\n\tAmount  int    `json:\"amount,omitempty\"`\n\tTxnID   int64  `json:\"txn_id,omitempty\"`\n\tBalance int    `json:\"balance\"`\n\tPending int    `json:\"pending,omitempty\"` // 该事件涉及对端的待付余额\n\tNote    string `json:\"note,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Sender 把一条转账消息送入网络（由 wiring 层注入网络 + 日志）。\ntype Sender func(to, amount int, txn int64)\n\n// Node 是一个银行网点节点。\ntype Node struct {\n\tid      int\n\tbalance int\n\ttxnSeq  int64\n\tpending map[int]int // 各出方向已发起、尚未划出的金额\n\tseenTxn map[int64]bool\n\tsend    Sender\n\tlog     func(Event)\n}\n\n// New 创建节点。\nfunc New(id, balance int, send Sender, log func(Event)) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{\n\t\tid:      id,\n\t\tbalance: balance,\n\t\tpending: map[int]int{},\n\t\tseenTxn: map[int64]bool{},\n\t\tsend:    send,\n\t\tlog:     log,\n\t}\n}\n\n// ID 返回节点编号。\nfunc (n *Node) ID() int { return n.id }\n\n// Balance 返回当前余额（含尚未划出的待付金额）。\nfunc (n *Node) Balance() int { return n.balance }\n\n// PendingTo 返回对某对端的待付金额。\nfunc (n *Node) PendingTo(peer int) int { return n.pending[peer] }\n\n// SnapshotState 返回快照用的节点状态。\nfunc (n *Node) SnapshotState() any {\n\tp := map[string]int{}\n\tfor k, v := range n.pending {\n\t\tif v != 0 {\n\t\t\tp[fmt.Sprintf(\"%d\", k)] = v\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn State{Balance: n.balance, Pending: p}\n}\n\n// Transfer 发起一笔向 to 的转账：登记待付并把消息发出，钱此时尚未划出。\n// 可用余额不足返回 false 且不产生任何副作用。\nfunc (n *Node) Transfer(to, amount int, at int64) bool {\n\tif amount <= 0 {\n\t\tpanic(fmt.Sprintf(\"bank: 转账金额必须为正: %d\", amount))\n\t}\n\tif amount > n.balance-n.pending[to] {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"insufficient\", Peer: to, Amount: amount,\n\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Pending: n.pending[to]})\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tn.txnSeq++\n\ttxn := n.txnSeq\n\tn.pending[to] += amount\n\tn.send(to, amount, txn)\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"send\", Peer: to, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn,\n\t\tBalance: n.balance, Pending: n.pending[to]})\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// Receive 处理一条投递到本节点的转账：金额 amount，事务号 txn，dup 表示网络重复副本。\nfunc (n *Node) Receive(from int, amount int, txn int64, at int64, dup bool) {\n\tif n.seenTxn[txn] {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"drop_dup\", Peer: from, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn,\n\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Note: \"重复转账，已忽略\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tn.seenTxn[txn] = true\n\tn.balance += amount\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"recv\", Peer: from, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn, Balance: n.balance})\n}\n\n// SettleOut 在“本节点记录快照状态之后、出信道 to 的标记离开之后”被调用，\n// 把该方向的全部待付金额划出（原论文中对“记录状态时在途中的自身发出消息”的处理）。\nfunc (n *Node) SettleOut(to int, at int64) {\n\tamt := n.pending[to]\n\tif amt == 0 {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tn.pending[to] = 0\n\tn.balance -= amt\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"settle\", Peer: to, Amount: amt,\n\t\tBalance: n.balance})\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_cdf366b8f7abf5e1a7a98240","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1085,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":70456,"output_tokens":1821,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_qdq10wj5knmqy66kt2tsnvnk":{"content":"// n.balance})","+}"]}],"originalFile":"// Package bank 实现“转账守恒模型”的节点：每个节点持有一个余额，\n// 转账是单向消息——发起方先本地扣款，收款方收到即入账。\n//\n// 这正是 Chandy–Lamport 原论文使用的银行模型：\n// 任意时刻恒有  所有节点余额之和 + 所有在途转账金额之和 = 初始总额。\n//\n// 幂等：网络可能重复投递，收款方按 TxnID 去重，重复副本不会重复入账。\n// 丢包（非可靠信道）会让资金停留在“已扣未入”状态，最终余额和变小——\n// 这也从反面说明可靠信道是 Chandy–Lamport 快照能够终止、守恒成立的前提。\npackage bank\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n)\n\n// State 是快照记录的节点可序列化状态。\ntype State struct {\n\tBalance int `json:\"balance\"`\n}\n\n// Event 是节点视角的业务日志条目（供输出与测试观察）。\ntype Event struct {\n\tAt      int64  `json:\"at\"`\n\tNode    int    `json:\"node\"`\n\tKind    string `json:\"kind\"` // send / recv / drop_dup / insufficient\n\tPeer    int    `json:\"peer\"`\n\tAmount  int    `json:\"amount,omitempty\"`\n\tTxnID   int64  `json:\"txn_id,omitempty\"`\n\tBalance int    `json:\"balance\"`\n\tNote    string `json:\"note,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Sender 把一条转账消息送入网络（由 wiring 层注入网络 + 日志）。\ntype Sender func(to, amount int, txn int64)\n\n// Node 是一个银行网点节点。\ntype Node struct {\n\tid      int\n\tbalance int\n\ttxnSeq  int64\n\tseenTxn map[int64]bool // 已入账的事务号（重复投递幂等）\n\tsend    Sender\n\tlog     func(Event)\n}\n\n// New 创建节点。\nfunc New(id, balance int, send Sender, log func(Event)) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{\n\t\tid:      id,\n\t\tbalance: balance,\n\t\tseenTxn: map[int64]bool{},\n\t\tsend:    send,\n\t\tlog:     log,\n\t}\n}\n\n// ID 返回节点编号。\nfunc (n *Node) ID() int { return n.id }\n\n// Balance 返回当前余额。\nfunc (n *Node) Balance() int { return n.balance }\n\n// SnapshotState 返回快照用的节点状态。\nfunc (n *Node) SnapshotState() any { return State{Balance: n.balance} }\n\n// Transfer 发起一笔向 to 的转账。余额不足返回 false 且不产生任何副作用。\nfunc (n *Node) Transfer(to, amount int, at int64) bool {\n\tif amount <= 0 {\n\t\tpanic(fmt.Sprintf(\"bank: 转账金额必须为正: %d\", amount))\n\t}\n\tif amount > n.balance {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"insufficient\", Peer: to, Amount: amount, Balance: n.balance})\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tn.txnSeq++\n\ttxn := n.txnSeq\n\tn.balance -= amount\n\tn.send(to, amount, txn)\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"send\", Peer: to, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn, Balance: n.balance})\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// Receive 处理一条投递到本节点的转账：金额 amount，事务号 txn，dup 表示网络重复副本。\nfunc (n *Node) Receive(from int, amount int, txn int64, at int64, dup bool) {\n\tif n.seenTxn[txn] {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"drop_dup\", Peer: from, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn, Balance: n.balance,\n\t\t\tNote: \"重复转账，已忽略\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tn.seenTxn[txn] = true\n\tn.balance += amount\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"recv\", Peer: from, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn, Balance: n.balance})\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"235cfcb1-c237-418a-bba0-08fadd3f345a","session_id":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp30/b","sessionId":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp30-b","slug":"glimmering-hopping-papert"}

Package bank 实现 Chandy–Lamport 原论文中的“转账守恒模型”节点。\n//\n// 资金守恒（关键设计），任意时刻恒有：\n//\n//\t所有节点 balance 之和 + 所有在途（未入账）转账金额之和 = 初始总额（无丢包时）\n//\n// 转账分两类处理：\n//\n//  1. 本节点【尚未记录快照状态】时发起的转账：不立即扣款，登记待付 pending；\n//     钱仍在 balance 中。待本节点记录状态、且沿该出信道的标记离开后，\n//     调用 SettleOut 把待付划出——它对应原论文中“记录状态时在途中的本节点发出消息”，\n//     既不重复计入在途收入，也不会漏算。\n//  2. 本节点【已记录快照状态】后发起的转账：立即正常扣款。此时标记已在它前面\n//     沿该出信道发出，收款方一定会先收到标记再收到这笔钱，故它绝不会进入本快照，\n//     立即扣款与“被算进收款方在途”恰好一致。\n//\n// 收款方收到转账即入账；网络重复投递按 TxnID 幂等去重。\npackage bank\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n)\n\n// State 是快照记录的节点可序列化状态。\ntype State struct {\n\tBalance int            `json:\"balance\"`\n\tPending map[string]int `json:\"pending\"` // 记录时刻尚未划出的待付金额，键为对端节点号\n}\n\n// Event 是节点视角的业务日志条目（供输出与测试观察）。\ntype Event struct {\n\tAt      int64  `json:\"at\"`\n\tNode    int    `json:\"node\"`\n\tKind    string `json:\"kind\"` // send / recv / settle / drop_dup / insufficient\n\tPeer    int    `json:\"peer\"`\n\tAmount  int    `json:\"amount,omitempty\"`\n\tTxnID   int64  `json:\"txn_id,omitempty\"`\n\tBalance int    `json:\"balance\"`\n\tPending int    `json:\"pending,omitempty\"`\n\tNote    string `json:\"note,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Sender 把一条转账消息送入网络（由 wiring 层注入网络 + 日志）。\ntype Sender func(to, amount int, txn int64)\n\n// Node 是一个银行网点节点。\ntype Node struct {\n\tid       int\n\tbalance  int\n\ttxnSeq   int64\n\tpending  map[int]int // 各出方向“记录状态前发起、尚未划出”的金额\n\trecorded bool        // 是否已记录某快照状态（银行模型中同一时间可只有一个记录切面）\n\tseenTxn  map[int64]bool\n\tsend     Sender\n\tlog      func(Event)\n}\n\n// New 创建节点。\nfunc New(id, balance int, send Sender, log func(Event)) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{\n\t\tid:      id,\n\t\tbalance: balance,\n\t\tpending: map[int]int{},\n\t\tseenTxn: map[int64]bool{},\n\t\tsend:    send,\n\t\tlog:     log,\n\t}\n}\n\n// ID 返回节点编号。\nfunc (n *Node) ID() int { return n.id }\n\n// Balance 返回当前余额。\nfunc (n *Node) Balance() int { return n.balance }\n\n// PendingTo 返回对某对端的待付金额。\nfunc (n *Node) PendingTo(peer int) int { return n.pending[peer] }\n\n// RecordedAt 报告节点是否已记录快照状态。\nfunc (n *Node) RecordedAt() bool { return n.recorded }\n\n// {\n\t\t\tp[fmt.Sprintf(\"%d\", k)] = v\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn State{Balance: n.balance, Pending: p}\n}\n\n// Transfer 发起一笔向 to 的转账。可用余额不足返回 false 且不产生任何副作用。\nfunc (n *Node) Transfer(to, amount int, at 原论文中的“转账守恒模型”节点。\n//\n// 资金守恒（关键设计）：\n//\n//\t所有节点 balance 之和 + 所有在途转账金额之和 = 初始总额（无丢包时）\n//\n// 为保证上式与全局状态快照相容，发起转账时不立即扣款，而是登记一笔待付 pending：\n// 钱仍在发起方 balance 中；待付额在“本节点记录状态之后、沿该出信道的标记之后”\n// 才真正划出（这正是 CL 算法对“记录状态时在途中的本节点发出消息”的处理位置）。\n//\n// 因此节点持久状态是 {balance, pending[peer]}；\n// 收款方收到转账即入账；重复投递按 TxnID 幂等去重。\n// 丢包（非可靠信道）会使待付永远无法划出，资金停在发起方余额里，总额仍守恒，\n// 但快照无法完成（标记收不全）——从反面说明可靠信道是 CL 快照终止的前提。\npackage bank\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n)\n\n// State 是快照记录的节点可序列化状态。\ntype State struct {\n\tBalance int            `json:\"balance\"`\n\tPending map[string]int `json:\"pending\"` // 待付金额，键为对端节点号\n}\n\n// Event 是节点视角的业务日志条目（供输出与测试观察）。\ntype Event struct {\n\tAt      int64  `json:\"at\"`\n\tNode    int    `json:\"node\"`\n\tKind    string `json:\"kind\"` // send / recv / settle / drop_dup / insufficient\n\tPeer    int    `json:\"peer\"`\n\tAmount  int    `json:\"amount,omitempty\"`\n\tTxnID   int64  `json:\"txn_id,omitempty\"`\n\tBalance int    `json:\"balance\"`\n\tPending int    `json:\"pending,omitempty\"` // 该事件涉及对端的待付余额\n\tNote    string `json:\"note,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Sender 把一条转账消息送入网络（由 wiring 层注入网络 + 日志）。\ntype Sender func(to, amount int, txn int64)\n\n// Node 是一个银行网点节点。\ntype Node struct {\n\tid      int\n\tbalance int\n\ttxnSeq  int64\n\tpending map[int]int // 各出方向已发起、尚未划出的金额\n\tseenTxn map[int64]bool\n\tsend    Sender\n\tlog     func(Event)\n}\n\n// New 创建节点。\nfunc New(id, balance int, send Sender, log func(Event)) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{\n\t\tid:      id,\n\t\tbalance: balance,\n\t\tpending: map[int]int{},\n\t\tseenTxn: map[int64]bool{},\n\t\tsend:    send,\n\t\tlog:     log,\n\t}\n}\n\n// ID 返回节点编号。\nfunc (n *Node) ID() int { return n.id }\n\n// Balance 返回当前余额（含尚未划出的待付金额）。\nfunc (n *Node) Balance() int { return n.balance }\n\n// PendingTo 返回对某对端的待付金额。\nfunc (n *Node) PendingTo(peer int) int { return n.pending[peer] }\n\n// SnapshotState 返回快照用的节点状态。\nfunc (n *Node) SnapshotState() any {\n\tp := map[string]int{}\n\tfor k, v := range n.pending {\n\t\tif v != 0 {\n\t\t\tp[fmt.Sprintf(\"%d\", k)] = v\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn State{Balance: n.balance, Pending: p}\n}\n\n// Transfer 发起一笔向 to 的转账：登记待付并把消息发出，钱此时尚未划出。\n// 可用余额不足返回 false 且不产生任何副作用。\nfunc (n *Node) Transfer(to, amount int, at int64) bool {\n\tif amount <= 0 {\n\t\tpanic(fmt.Sprintf(\"bank: 转账金额必须为正: %d\", amount))\n\t}\n\tif amount > n.balance-n.pending[to] {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"insufficient\", Peer: to, Amount: amount,\n\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Pending: n.pending[to]})\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tn.txnSeq++\n\ttxn := n.txnSeq\n\tn.pending[to] += amount\n\tn.send(to, amount, txn)\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"send\", Peer: to, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn,\n\t\tBalance: n.balance, Pending: n.pending[to]})\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// Receive 处理一条投递到本节点的转账：金额 amount，事务号 txn，dup 表示网络重复副本。\nfunc (n *Node) Receive(from int, amount int, txn int64, at int64, dup bool) {\n\tif n.seenTxn[txn] {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"drop_dup\", Peer: from, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn,\n\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Note: \"重复转账，已忽略\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tn.seenTxn[txn] = true\n\tn.balance += amount\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"recv\", Peer: from, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn, Balance: n.balance})\n}\n\n// SettleOut 在“本节点记录快照状态之后、出信道 to 的标记离开之后”被调用，\n// 把该方向的全部待付金额划出（原论文中对“记录状态时在途中的自身发出消息”的处理）。\nfunc (n *Node) SettleOut(to int, at int64) {\n\tamt := n.pending[to]\n\tif amt == 0 {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tn.pending[to] = 0\n\tn.balance -= amt\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"settle\", Peer: to, Amount: amt,\n\t\tBalance: n.balance})\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"55148966-a868-4108-a421-06ad19388d83","session_id":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp30/b","sessionId":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp30-b","slug":"glimmering-hopping-papert"}

Package bank 实现 Chandy–Lamport 原论文中的“转账守恒模型”节点。\n//\n// 资金守恒（关键设计），任意时刻恒有：\n//\n//\t所有节点 balance 之和 + 所有在途（未入账）转账金额之和 = 初始总额（无丢包时）\n//\n// 每个出方向维护一个“标记前队列” pre[to]：记录该方向上“身后还没有跟着标记”的\n// 已发消息金额。发起一笔快照时（也就是本节点记录本地状态的瞬间），在沿出信道\n// 发送标记【之前】，先把该队列里的金额划出——这些正是“记录状态时在途中、由本节点\n// 发出”的消息：按 CL 语义它们由发起方负责，绝不进入任何收款方的在途记录。\n//\n// 一旦某方向有标记排在队列中消息之后，之后发起的新转账立即扣款：FIFO 保证\n// 收款方会先收到标记、再收到这些新消息，因此它们不会进入快照的在途记录。\n// 多个快照交叠时，每个快照各自再走一次“划出 + 发标记”，彼此独立。\n//\n// 收款方收到转账即入账；网络重复投递按 TxnID 幂等去重。\npackage bank\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n)\n\n// State 是快照记录的节点可序列化状态。\ntype State struct {\n\tBalance int `json:\"balance\"`\n}\n\n// Event 是节点视角的业务日志条目（供输出与测试观察）。\ntype Event struct {\n\tAt      int64  `json:\"at\"`\n\tNode    int    `json:\"node\"`\n\tKind    string `json:\"kind\"` // send / recv / settle / drop_dup / insufficient\n\tPeer    int    `json:\"peer\"`\n\tAmount  int    `json:\"amount,omitempty\"`\n\tTxnID   int64  `json:\"txn_id,omitempty\"`\n\tBalance int    `json:\"balance\"`\n\tPre     int    `json:\"pre,omitempty\"` // 事件后该方向“标记前队列”的待划金额\n\tNote    string `json:\"note,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Sender 把一条转账消息送入网络（由 wiring 层注入网络 + 日志）。\ntype Sender func(to, amount int, txn int64)\n\n// Node 是一个银行网点节点。\ntype Node struct {\n\tid      int\n\tbalance int\n\ttxnSeq  int64\n\tpre     map[int]int // pre[to]：to 方向上“身后尚无标记跟随”的已发消息金额合计\n\tseenTxn map[int64]bool\n\tsend    Sender\n\tlog     func(Event)\n}\n\n// New 创建节点。\nfunc New(id, balance int, send Sender, log func(Event)) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{\n\t\tid:      id,\n\t\tbalance: balance,\n\t\tpre:     map[int]int{},\n\t\tseenTxn: map[int64]bool{},\n\t\tsend:    send,\n\t\tlog:     log,\n\t}\n}\n\n// ID 返回节点编号。\nfunc (n *Node) ID() int { return n.id }\n\n// Balance 返回当前余额。\nfunc (n *Node) Balance() int { return n.balance }\n\n// PreTo 返回某出方向标记前队列中尚未划出的金额。\nfunc (n *Node) PreTo(peer int) int { return n.pre[peer] }\n\n// SnapshotState 返回快照用的节点状态。\nfunc (n *Node) SnapshotState() any { return State{Balance: n.balance} }\n\n// Transfer 发起一笔向 to 的转账。可用余额不足返回 false 且不产生任何副作用。\nfunc (n *Node) Transfer(to, amount int, at int64) bool {\n\tif amount <= 0 {\n\t\tpanic(fmt.Sprintf(\"bank: 转账金额必须为正: %d\", amount))\n\t}\n\tif amount > n.balance-n.pre[to] {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"insufficient\", Peer: to, Amount: amount,\n\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Pre: n.pre[to]})\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tn.txnSeq++\n\ttxn := n.txnSeq\n\tif n.pre[to] < 0 {\n\t\t// pre[to] < 0 表示该方向已有标记在途：标记之后的新消息立即扣款。\n\t\tn.balance -= amount\n\t} else {\n\t\t// 标记之前：暂挂，等本节点发起下一次快照、发标记前划出。\n\t\tn.pre[to] += amount\n\t}\n\tn.send(to, amount, txn)\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"send\", Peer: to, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn,\n\t\tBalance: n.balance, Pre: n.pre[to]})\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// Receive 处理一条投递到本节点的转账。dup 表示网络重复副本。\nfunc (n *Node) Receive(from int, amount int, txn int64, at int64, dup bool) {\n\tif n.seenTxn[txn] {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"drop_dup\", Peer: from, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn,\n\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Note: \"重复转账，已忽略\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tn.seenTxn[txn] = 返回当前余额。\nfunc (n *Node) Balance() int { return n.balance }\n\n// PreTo 返回某出方向标记前队列中尚未划出的金额。\nfunc (n *Node) PreTo(peer int) int { return n.pre[peer] }\n\n// SnapshotState 返回快照用的节点状态。\nfunc (n *Node) bank 实现 Chandy–Lamport 原论文中的“转账守恒模型”节点。\n//\n// 资金守恒（关键设计），任意时刻恒有：\n//\n//\t所有节点 balance 之和 + 所有在途（未入账）转账金额之和 = 初始总额（无丢包时）\n//\n// 转账分两类处理：\n//\n//  1. 本节点【尚未记录快照状态】时发起的转账：不立即扣款，登记待付 pending；\n//     钱仍在 balance 中。待本节点记录状态、且沿该出信道的标记离开后，\n//     调用 SettleOut 把待付划出——它对应原论文中“记录状态时在途中的本节点发出消息”，\n//     既不重复计入在途收入，也不会漏算。\n//  2. 本节点【已记录快照状态】后发起的转账：立即正常扣款。此时标记已在它前面\n//     沿该出信道发出，收款方一定会先收到标记再收到这笔钱，故它绝不会进入本快照，\n//     立即扣款与“被算进收款方在途”恰好一致。\n//\n// 收款方收到转账即入账；网络重复投递按 TxnID 幂等去重。\npackage bank\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n)\n\n// State 是快照记录的节点可序列化状态。\ntype State struct {\n\tBalance int            `json:\"balance\"`\n\tPending map[string]int `json:\"pending\"` // 记录时刻尚未划出的待付金额，键为对端节点号\n}\n\n// Event 是节点视角的业务日志条目（供输出与测试观察）。\ntype Event struct {\n\tAt      int64  `json:\"at\"`\n\tNode    int    `json:\"node\"`\n\tKind    string `json:\"kind\"` // send / recv / settle / drop_dup / insufficient\n\tPeer    int    `json:\"peer\"`\n\tAmount  int    `json:\"amount,omitempty\"`\n\tTxnID   int64  `json:\"txn_id,omitempty\"`\n\tBalance int    `json:\"balance\"`\n\tPending int    `json:\"pending,omitempty\"`\n\tNote    string `json:\"note,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Sender 把一条转账消息送入网络（由 wiring 层注入网络 + 日志）。\ntype Sender func(to, amount int, txn int64)\n\n// Node 是一个银行网点节点。\ntype Node struct {\n\tid       int\n\tbalance  int\n\ttxnSeq   int64\n\tpending  map[int]int // 各出方向“记录状态前发起、尚未划出”的金额\n\trecorded bool        // 是否已记录某快照状态（银行模型中同一时间可只有一个记录切面）\n\tseenTxn  map[int64]bool\n\tsend     Sender\n\tlog      func(Event)\n}\n\n// New 创建节点。\nfunc New(id, balance int, send Sender, log func(Event)) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{\n\t\tid:      id,\n\t\tbalance: balance,\n\t\tpending: map[int]int{},\n\t\tseenTxn: map[int64]bool{},\n\t\tsend:    send,\n\t\tlog:     log,\n\t}\n}\n\n// ID 返回节点编号。\nfunc (n *Node) ID() int { return n.id }\n\n// Balance 返回当前余额。\nfunc (n *Node) Balance() int { return n.balance }\n\n// PendingTo 返回对某对端的待付金额。\nfunc (n *Node) PendingTo(peer int) int { return n.pending[peer] }\n\n// RecordedAt 报告节点是否已记录快照状态。\nfunc (n *Node) RecordedAt() bool { return n.recorded }\n\n// SnapshotState 返回快照用的节点状态，并把节点标记为“已记录切面”。\nfunc (n *Node) SnapshotState() any {\n\tn.recorded = true\n\tp := map[string]int{}\n\tfor k, v := range n.pending {\n\t\tif v != 0 {\n\t\t\tp[fmt.Sprintf(\"%d\", k)] = v\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn State{Balance: n.balance, Pending: p}\n}\n\n// Transfer 发起一笔向 to 的转账。可用余额不足返回 false 且不产生任何副作用。\nfunc (n *Node) Transfer(to, amount int, at int64) bool {\n\tif amount <= 0 {\n\t\tpanic(fmt.Sprintf(\"bank: 转账金额必须为正: %d\", amount))\n\t}\n\tif amount > n.balance-n.pending[to] {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"insufficient\", Peer: to, Amount: amount,\n\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Pending: n.pending[to]})\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tn.txnSeq++\n\ttxn := n.txnSeq\n\tif n.recorded {\n\t\t// 记录切面之后：标记已先行，这笔钱必不属于当前快照，直接扣款。\n\t\tn.balance -= amount\n\t} else {\n\t\t// 记录切面之前：挂待付，等出信道标记离开后划出。\n\t\tn.pending[to] += amount\n\t}\n\tn.send(to, amount, txn)\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"send\", Peer: to, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn,\n\t\tBalance: n.balance, Pending: n.pending[to]})\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// Receive 处理一条投递到本节点的转账。dup 表示网络重复副本。\nfunc (n *Node) Receive(from int, amount int, txn int64, at int64, dup bool) {\n\tif n.seenTxn[txn] {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"drop_dup\", Peer: from, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn,\n\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Note: \"重复转账，已忽略\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tn.seenTxn[txn] = true\n\tn.balance += amount\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"recv\", Peer: from, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn, Balance: n.balance})\n}\n\n// SettleOut 在“本节点记录快照状态后、出信道 to 的标记离开”时调用，\n// 把记录状态前发起、仍挂在该方向的待付金额划出。\nfunc (n *Node) SettleOut(to int, at int64) {\n\tamt := n.pending[to]\n\tif amt == 0 {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tn.pending[to] = 0\n\tn.balance -= amt\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"settle\", Peer: to, Amount: amt, Balance: n.balance})\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"ee61c392-48c8-4513-87ea-fef1ebb2563b","session_id":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp30/b","sessionId":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp30-b","slug":"glimmering-hopping-papert"}

Package bank 实现 Chandy–Lamport 原论文中的“转账守恒模型”节点。\n//\n// 任意时刻（无丢包）恒有资金守恒：\n//\n//\t所有节点 balance 之和 + 所有在途（未入账）转账金额之和 = 初始总额\n//\n// 出账语义（标准 Chandy–Lamport 银行模型）：\n//\n// 每个出方向维护一个按发送顺序的队列。每个快照在该方向上对应一道“屏障标记”，\n// 队列被标记切成若干段：\n//\n//  1. 发起转账时，节点把金额挂到该方向队列末尾（钱暂不扣，仍计入 balance）；\n//  2. 节点为某快照【记录本地状态】的同一刻，在每个出方向队列尾部插入该快照的标记；\n//     插入动作把“标记之前尚未划出的所有金额”从 balance 划出——这些消息\n//     记录时刻已在途中，按 CL 语义归本节点负责，不会进入任何收款方的在途记录；\n//  3. 标记之后新发起的转账挂在标记后面，保持未扣款状态；它们会被收款方\n//     计入在途消息（FIFO 保证收款方先见标记后见钱），同样不重复不漏算；\n//  4. 当本节点在该方向收到对端回传的同一快照标记时（FIFO 意味着此前发出的消息\n//     都已送达），把该标记连同它之前的消息一并出队。\n//\n// 多快照交叠：队列上可同时存在多个标记，各切各的段，互不串台。\n//\n// 收款方收到转账即入账；网络重复投递按 TxnID 幂等去重。\npackage bank\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"sort\"\n)\n\n// State 是快照记录的节点可序列化状态。\ntype State struct {\n\tBalance int `json:\"balance\"`\n}\n\n// Event 是节点视角的业务日志条目（供输出与测试观察）。\ntype Event struct {\n\tAt      int64  `json:\"at\"`\n\tNode    int    `json:\"node\"`\n\tKind    string `json:\"kind\"` // send / recv / settle / flush / drop_dup / insufficient\n\tPeer    int    `json:\"peer\"`\n\tAmount  int    `json:\"amount,omitempty\"`\n\tTxnID   int64  `json:\"txn_id,omitempty\"`\n\tBalance int    `json:\"balance\"`\n\tQueued  int    `json:\"queued,omitempty\"` // 事件后该方向队列中未划出的金额\n\tNote    string `json:\"note,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Sender 把一条转账消息送入网络（由 wiring 层注入网络 + 日志）。\ntype Sender func(to, amount int, txn int64)\n\ntype qEntry struct {\n\tamount  int\n\ttxn     int64\n\tsettled bool // 是否已被其前面某道标记划出\n\tisMarker bool\n\tsnapID  int\n}\n\n// Node 是一个银行网点节点。\ntype Node struct {\n\tid      int\n\tbalance int\n\ttxnSeq  int64\n\toutq    map[int][]*qEntry // 各出方向按发送顺序的消息/标记队列\n\tseenTxn map[int64]bool\n\tsend    Sender\n\tlog     func(Event)\n}\n\n// New 创建节点。\nfunc New(id, balance int, send Sender, log func(Event)) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{\n\t\tid:      id,\n\t\tbalance: balance,\n\t\toutq:    map[int][]*qEntry{},\n\t\tseenTxn: map[int64]bool{},\n\t\tsend:    send,\n\t\tlog: Receive 处理一条投递到本节点的转账。dup 表示网络重复副本。\nfunc (n *Node) Receive(from int, amount int, txn int64, at int64, dup bool) {\n\tif n.seenTxn[txn] {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"drop_dup\", Peer: from, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn,\n\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Note: \"重复转账，已忽略\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tn.seenTxn[txn] = true\n\tn.balance += amount\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"recv\", {\n\t\t\t\texists = true\n\t\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif exists {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tsettled := 0\n\t\tfor _, e := range q {\n\t\t\tif !e.isMarker && !e.settled {\n\t\t\t\te.settled = true\n\t\t\t\tsettled += e.amount\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif settled > 0 {\n\t\t\tn.balance -= settled\n\t\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"settle\", Peer: to, Amount: settled,\n\t\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Queued: n.QueuedTo(to)})\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.outq[to] = append(n.outq[to], &qEntry{isMarker: true, snapID: snapID})\n\t\tout[to] = settled\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// {\n\t\tif e.isMarker && e.snapID == snapID {\n\t\t\tidx = i\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif idx < 0 {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tflushed := 0\n\tfor _, e := range q[:idx+1] {\n\t\tif !e.isMarker + 所有在途（未入账）转账金额之和 = 初始总额（无丢包时）\n//\n// 每个出方向维护一个“标记前队列” pre[to]：记录该方向上“身后还没有跟着标记”的\n// 已发消息金额。发起一笔快照时（也就是本节点记录本地状态的瞬间），在沿出信道\n// 发送标记【之前】，先把该队列里的金额划出——这些正是“记录状态时在途中、由本节点\n// 发出”的消息：按 CL 语义它们由发起方负责，绝不进入任何收款方的在途记录。\n//\n// 一旦某方向有标记排在队列中消息之后，之后发起的新转账立即扣款：FIFO 保证\n// 收款方会先收到标记、再收到这些新消息，因此它们不会进入快照的在途记录。\n// 多个快照交叠时，每个快照各自再走一次“划出 + 发标记”，彼此独立。\n//\n// 收款方收到转账即入账；网络重复投递按 TxnID 幂等去重。\npackage bank\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n)\n\n// State 是快照记录的节点可序列化状态。\ntype State struct {\n\tBalance int `json:\"balance\"`\n}\n\n// Event 是节点视角的业务日志条目（供输出与测试观察）。\ntype Event struct {\n\tAt      int64  `json:\"at\"`\n\tNode    int    `json:\"node\"`\n\tKind    string `json:\"kind\"` // send / recv / settle / drop_dup / insufficient\n\tPeer    int    `json:\"peer\"`\n\tAmount  int    `json:\"amount,omitempty\"`\n\tTxnID   int64  `json:\"txn_id,omitempty\"`\n\tBalance int    `json:\"balance\"`\n\tPre     int    `json:\"pre,omitempty\"` // 事件后该方向“标记前队列”的待划金额\n\tNote    string `json:\"note,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Sender 把一条转账消息送入网络（由 wiring 层注入网络 + 日志）。\ntype Sender func(to, amount int, txn int64)\n\n// Node 是一个银行网点节点。\ntype Node struct {\n\tid      int\n\tbalance int\n\ttxnSeq  int64\n\tpre     map[int]int // pre[to]：to 方向上“身后尚无标记跟随”的已发消息金额合计\n\tseenTxn map[int64]bool\n\tsend    Sender\n\tlog     func(Event)\n}\n\n// New 创建节点。\nfunc New(id, balance int, send Sender, log func(Event)) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{\n\t\tid:      id,\n\t\tbalance: balance,\n\t\tpre:     map[int]int{},\n\t\tseenTxn: map[int64]bool{},\n\t\tsend:    send,\n\t\tlog:     log,\n\t}\n}\n\n// ID 返回节点编号。\nfunc (n *Node) ID() int { return n.id }\n\n// Balance 返回当前余额。\nfunc (n *Node) Balance() int { return n.balance }\n\n// PreTo 返回某出方向标记前队列中尚未划出的金额。\nfunc (n *Node) PreTo(peer int) int { return n.pre[peer] }\n\n// SnapshotState 返回快照用的节点状态。\nfunc (n *Node) SnapshotState() any { return State{Balance: n.balance} }\n\n// Transfer 发起一笔向 to 的转账。可用余额不足返回 false 且不产生任何副作用。\nfunc (n *Node) Transfer(to, amount int, at int64) bool {\n\tif amount <= 0 {\n\t\tpanic(fmt.Sprintf(\"bank: 转账金额必须为正: %d\", amount))\n\t}\n\tif amount > n.balance-n.pre[to] {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"insufficient\", Peer: to, Amount: amount,\n\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Pre: n.pre[to]})\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tn.txnSeq++\n\ttxn := n.txnSeq\n\tif n.pre[to] < 0 {\n\t\t// pre[to] < 0 表示该方向已有标记在途：标记之后的新消息立即扣款。\n\t\tn.balance -= amount\n\t} else {\n\t\t// 标记之前：暂挂，等本节点发起下一次快照、发标记前划出。\n\t\tn.pre[to] += amount\n\t}\n\tn.send(to, amount, txn)\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"send\", Peer: to, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn,\n\t\tBalance: n.balance, Pre: n.pre[to]})\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// Receive 处理一条投递到本节点的转账。dup 表示网络重复副本。\nfunc (n *Node) Receive(from int, amount int, txn int64, at int64, dup bool) {\n\tif n.seenTxn[txn] {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"drop_dup\", Peer: from, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn,\n\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Note: \"重复转账，已忽略\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tn.seenTxn[txn] = true\n\tn.balance += amount\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"recv\", Peer: from, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn, Balance: n.balance})\n}\n\n// SettleForSnapshot 在本节点【记录本地状态、沿出信道发标记之前】调用。\n// 它把每个出方向标记前队列的金额划出，并翻转该方向为“标记在途”（负值哨兵）。\n// 每个快照发起时调用一次；交叠快照之间已翻转的方向不会被重复处理。\nfunc (n *Node) SettleForSnapshot(at int64) {\n\tpeers := make([]int, 0, len(n.pre))\n\tfor p := range n.pre {\n\t\tpeers = append(peers, p)\n\t}\n\t// 确定性：按对端排序处理。\n\tfor i := 1; i < len(peers); i++ {\n\t\tfor j := i; j > 0 && peers[j-1] > peers[j]; j-- {\n\t\t\tpeers[j-1], peers[j] = peers[j], peers[j-1]\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tfor _, to := range peers {\n\t\tamt := n.pre[to]\n\t\tif amt <= 0 {\n\t\t\tcontinue // 该方向已为某次快照划过（负值哨兵）\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.balance -= amt\n\t\tn.pre[to] = -1 // 标记在途；之后该方向新转账立即扣款\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"settle\", Peer: to, Amount: amt,\n\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Pre: n.pre[to]})\n\t}\n}\n\n// MarkerReturned 在本节点收到某邻居沿“本节点 -> 邻居”方向回传的标记时调用，\n// 清除该方向的在途哨兵，使后续转账重新走“挂队列”流程（为下一个可能的快照做准备）。\nfunc (n *Node) MarkerReturned(from int) {\n\tif n.pre[from] < 0 {\n\t\tn.pre[from] = 0\n\t}\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"19da7922-2313-4b81-a394-16363b2856f7","session_id":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp30/b","sessionId":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp30-b","slug":"glimmering-hopping-papert"}
