{"parentUuid":"1c0d8cdb-296d-425c-831c-9ff968957478","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"text":"我现在完全理清了标准 CL 银行模型的正确账务：**发起即挂账 pending（不扣款）；收到标记记录状态的同一刻，把所有出方向 pending 作为状态一部分划出**。这样在途消息的钱天然只归属一次（要么发起方 pending、要么在途信道、要么收款方余额）。删掉之前的 out_after 补丁路线，重写：\n","type":"text"}],"id":"msg_1998526820867e22695d3d08","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1249,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":99128,"output_tokens":2012,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"apiBlockIndex":1,"type":"assistant","uuid":"9980de34-7622-4937-a805-11a3fa512480","timestamp":"2026-09-23T06:10:29.003Z","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp30/b","sessionId":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp30-b","slug":"glimmering-hopping-papert"}
{"parentUuid":"9980de34-7622-4937-a805-11a3fa512480","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_lmbmnvqiyebik17q1jpck1hb","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp30/b/internal/bank/node.go","content":"// Package bank 实现 Chandy–Lamport 原论文中的“转账守恒模型”节点。\n//\n// 资金守恒：任意时刻恒有\n//\n//\tΣ 节点已落定余额(balance) + Σ 已发起未划出(pending) + Σ 未入账在途转账 = 初始总额\n//\n// 账务规则（与快照协议精确对齐）：\n//\n//  1. 发起转账：不立即扣款，金额计入对该对端的 pending（钱仍属本节点），消息入网；\n//  2. 节点为某快照【记录本地状态】的同一刻：把所有出方向 pending 划出（balance 减少），\n//     pending 余额作为记录状态的一部分——这正是原论文中“记录状态时在途中、\n//     由本节点发出”的消息。此后沿各出信道发出标记；\n//  3. 上一步之后新发起的转账仍挂 pending：FIFO 保证收款方先收到标记，\n//     因此这些钱会被收款方计入在途消息，直到对端回传标记、节点把 pending 再次\n//     “结算/释放”为止（见 ReleaseAfterMarker）；\n//  4. 收款方收到转账即入账；重复投递按 TxnID 幂等去重。\n//\n// 多快照交叠：每次记录状态都会把当时全部 pending 划出并记进该快照，\n// 各快照的状态与在途记录彼此独立。\npackage bank\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"sort\"\n)\n\n// State 是快照记录的节点状态。\ntype State struct {\n\tBalance int `json:\"balance\"` // 记录时刻的已落定余额（pending 已划出）\n\tPending int `json:\"pending\"` // 记录时刻划出的在途出账金额合计\n}\n\n// Event 是节点视角的业务日志条目。\ntype Event struct {\n\tAt      int64  `json:\"at\"`\n\tNode    int    `json:\"node\"`\n\tKind    string `json:\"kind\"` // send / recv / settle / release / drop_dup / insufficient\n\tPeer    int    `json:\"peer\"`\n\tAmount  int    `json:\"amount,omitempty\"`\n\tTxnID   int64  `json:\"txn_id,omitempty\"`\n\tBalance int    `json:\"balance\"`\n\tPending int    `json:\"pending,omitempty\"`\n\tNote    string `json:\"note,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Sender 把一条转账消息送入网络。\ntype Sender func(to, amount int, txn int64)\n\n// Node 是一个银行网点节点。\ntype Node struct {\n\tid      int\n\tbalance int\n\ttxnSeq  int64\n\tpending map[int]int // 各出方向已发起、尚未划出的金额\n\tseenTxn map[int64]bool\n\tsend    Sender\n\tlog     func(Event)\n}\n\n// New 创建节点。\nfunc New(id, balance int, send Sender, log func(Event)) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{\n\t\tid:      id,\n\t\tbalance: balance,\n\t\tpending: map[int]int{},\n\t\tseenTxn: map[int64]bool{},\n\t\tsend:    send,\n\t\tlog:     log,\n\t}\n}\n\n// ID 返回节点编号。\nfunc (n *Node) ID() int { return n.id }\n\n// Balance 返回已落定余额。\nfunc (n *Node) Balance() int { return n.balance }\n\n// TotalPending 返回所有出方向 pending 金额合计。\nfunc (n *Node) TotalPending() int {\n\tt := 0\n\tfor _, v := range n.pending {\n\t\tt += v\n\t}\n\treturn t\n}\n\n// Transfer 发起一笔向 to 的转账：挂 pending、发消息，暂不动 balance。余额不足返回 false。\nfunc (n *Node) Transfer(to, amount int, at int64) bool {\n\tif amount <= 0 {\n\t\tpanic(fmt.Sprintf(\"bank: 转账金额必须为正: %d\", amount))\n\t}\n\tif amount > n.balance-n.TotalPending() {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"insufficient\", Peer: to, Amount: amount,\n\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Pending: n.TotalPending()})\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tn.txnSeq++\n\ttxn := n.txnSeq\n\tn.pending[to] += amount\n\tn.send(to, amount, txn)\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"send\", Peer: to, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn,\n\t\tBalance: n.balance, Pending: n.TotalPending()})\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// Receive 处理一条投递到本节点的转账。dup 表示网络重复副本。\nfunc (n *Node) Receive(from int, amount int, txn int64, at int64, dup bool) {\n\tif n.seenTxn[txn] {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"drop_dup\", Peer: from, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn,\n\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Note: \"重复转账，已忽略\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tn.seenTxn[txn] = true\n\tn.balance += amount\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"recv\", Peer: from, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn, Balance: n.balance})\n}\n\n// RecordState 在节点为快照 snapID 记录本地状态的同一刻调用：\n// 把当前全部出方向 pending 划出，返回记录下来的状态。幂等（同一 snapID 只结算一次）。\nfunc (n *Node) RecordState(snapID int, at int64) State {\n\tif n.settledSnap(snapID) {\n\t\treturn State{Balance: n.balance}\n\t}\n\tn.markSettled(snapID)\n\n\tpendingTotal := n.TotalPending()\n\tif pendingTotal > 0 {\n\t\tn.balance -= pendingTotal\n\t\tpeers := make([]int, 0, len(n.pending))\n\t\tfor p, v := range n.pending {\n\t\t\tif v > 0 {\n\t\t\t\tpeers = append(peers, p)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tsort.Ints(peers)\n\t\tfor _, p := range peers {\n\t\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"settle\", Peer: p, Amount: n.pending[p],\n\t\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Pending: n.TotalPending()})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn State{Balance: n.balance, Pending: pendingTotal}\n}\n\n// ReleasePendingFor 在“本节点发出的 snapID 标记从对端返回（收到对端->本节点同 ID 标记）”\n// 之后调用：FIFO 保证该方向标记之前的消息全部送达，把对应 pending 清零，\n// 使这部分额度可用于下一次快照的结算。金额此前已在记录状态时划出，这里不再动 balance。\nfunc (n *Node) ReleasePendingFor(peer int) {\n\tif n.pending[peer] != 0 {\n\t\tn.pending[peer] = 0\n\t}\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_1998526820867e22695d3d08","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1249,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":99128,"output_tokens":2012,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_lmbmnvqiyebik17q1jpck1hb":{"content":"// {"parentUuid":"4136bf93-c79c-40c7-9eb6-46a1c24426ea","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_zdzoy6vp1ku1ty5vk860v3wi","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp30/b/internal/bank/node.go","content":"// Package bank 实现 Chandy–Lamport 原论文中的“转账守恒模型”节点。\n//\n// 全局资金守恒，任意时刻（无丢包）恒有：\n//\n//\tΣ 节点 balance + Σ 网络中未入账的在途转账金额 = 初始总额\n//\n// 账务与快照协议严格对齐：\n//\n//  1. 发起转账：金额计入对该对端的 pending（暂不从 balance 扣），消息入网；\n//  2. 节点为某快照【记录本地状态】的同一刻：把当前全部 pending 从 balance 划出，\n//     并把划出额记进该快照的节点状态（pending 字段）。这正是原论文中\n//     “记录状态时在途中、由本节点发出”的消息——FIFO 保证它们不可能进入任何\n//     收款方的在途记录，故归本节点负责，不漏不重；\n//  3. 收到某对端发来的快照标记（意味着该方向上本节点标记之前的消息均已送达）后，\n//     清零该方向的 pending 记录（钱早在第 2 步划出，这里只释放记账槽位）；\n//  4. 第 2 步之后新发起的转账仍挂 pending：收款方先见标记后见钱，会被计入\n//     收款方在途消息；下一个快照记录状态时再由本节点划出；\n//  5. 收款方收到转账即入账；网络重复投递按 TxnID 幂等去重。\n//\n// 多快照交叠时，每次记录状态都对“当时的 pending”快照留一份，彼此独立。\npackage bank\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"sort\"\n)\n\n// State 是快照记录的节点状态。\ntype State struct {\n\tBalance int `json:\"balance\"` // 记录时刻余额（当时 pending 已划出）\n\tPending int `json:\"pending\"` // 记录时刻划出的在途出账金额合计\n}\n\n// Event 是节点视角的业务日志条目。\ntype Event struct {\n\tAt      int64  `json:\"at\"`\n\tNode    int    `json:\"node\"`\n\tKind    string `json:\"kind\"` // send / recv / settle / drop_dup / insufficient\n\tPeer    int    `json:\"peer\"`\n\tAmount  int    `json:\"amount,omitempty\"`\n\tTxnID   int64  `json:\"txn_id,omitempty\"`\n\tBalance int    `json:\"balance\"`\n\tPending int    `json:\"pending,omitempty\"`\n\tNote    string `json:\"note,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Sender 把一条转账消息送入网络。\ntype Sender func(to, amount int, txn int64)\n\n// Node 是一个银行网点节点。\ntype Node struct {\n\tid          int\n\tbalance     int\n\ttxnSeq      int64\n\tpending     map[int]int // 各出方向已发起、尚未释放的金额\n\tsettledSnap map[int]bool\n\tseenTxn     map[int64]bool\n\tsend        Sender\n\tlog         func(Event)\n}\n\n// New 创建节点。\nfunc New(id, balance int, send Sender, log func(Event)) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{\n\t\tid:          id,\n\t\tbalance:     balance,\n\t\tpending:     map[int]int{},\n\t\tsettledSnap: map[int]bool{},\n\t\tseenTxn:     map[int64]bool{},\n\t\tsend:        send,\n\t\tlog:         log,\n\t}\n}\n\n// ID 返回节点编号。\nfunc (n *Node) ID() int { return n.id }\n\n// Balance 返回已落定余额（pending 金额在记录状态前仍包含在内）。\nfunc (n *Node) Balance() int { return n.balance }\n\n// TotalPending 返回所有出方向 pending 金额合计。\nfunc (n *Node) TotalPending() int {\n\tt := 0\n\tfor _, v := range n.pending {\n\t\tt += v\n\t}\n\treturn t\n}\n\n// Transfer 发起一笔向 to 的转账：挂 pending、发消息，暂不动 balance。可用不足返回 false。\nfunc (n *Node) Transfer(to, amount int, at int64) bool {\n\tif amount <= 0 {\n\t\tpanic(fmt.Sprintf(\"bank: 转账金额必须为正: %d\", amount))\n\t}\n\tif amount > n.balance-n.TotalPending() {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"insufficient\", Peer: to, Amount: amount,\n\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Pending: n.TotalPending()})\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tn.txnSeq++\n\ttxn := n.txnSeq\n\tn.pending[to] += amount\n\tn.send(to, amount, txn)\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"send\", Peer: to, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn,\n\t\tBalance: n.balance, Pending: n.TotalPending()})\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// Receive 处理一条投递到本节点的转账。dup 表示网络重复副本。\nfunc (n *Node) Receive(from int, amount int, txn int64, at int64, dup bool) {\n\tif n.seenTxn[txn] {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"drop_dup\", Peer: from, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn,\n\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Note: \"重复转账，已忽略\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tn.seenTxn[txn] = true\n\tn.balance += amount\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"recv\", Peer: from, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn, Balance: n.balance})\n}\n\n// RecordState 在节点为快照 snapID 记录本地状态的同一刻调用：\n// 把当前全部 pending 从 balance 划出，并返回记录状态（含划出额）。\n// 幂等：同一快照重复调用返回当时状态而不重复结算。\nfunc (n *Node) RecordState(snapID int, at int64) State {\n\tif n.settledSnap[snapID] {\n\t\treturn State{Balance: n.balance}\n\t}\n\tn.settledSnap[snapID] = true\n\n\tpendingTotal := n.TotalPending()\n\tif pendingTotal > 0 {\n\t\tn.balance -= pendingTotal\n\t\tpeers := make([]int, 0, len(n.pending))\n\t\tfor p, v := range n.pending {\n\t\t\tif v > 0 {\n\t\t\t\tpeers = append(peers, p)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tsort.Ints(peers)\n\t\tfor _, p := range peers {\n\t\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"settle\", Peer: p, Amount: n.pending[p],\n\t\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Pending: n.TotalPending()})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn State{Balance: n.balance, Pending: pendingTotal}\n}\n\n// ReleaseInbound 在节点收到来自 peer 的快照标记时调用：\n// peer -> node 方向标记到达意味着 node 沿 node->peer 方向发出、在标记之前的消息\n// 都已送达并被对端处理，释放该方向的 pending 记账槽位（不再影响可用余额判断）。\nfunc (n *Node) ReleaseInbound(peer int) {\n\tn.pending[peer] = 0\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_0262a2ca02b4ea9d770cd040","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2205,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":100152,"output_tokens":2027,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_zdzoy6vp1ku1ty5vk860v3wi":{"content":"// bank\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"sort\"\n)\n\n// State 是快照记录的节点状态。\ntype State struct {\n\tBalance int `json:\"balance\"` // 记录时刻的已落定余额（pending 已划出）\n\tPending int `json:\"pending\"` // 记录时刻划出的在途出账金额合计\n}\n\n// Event 是节点视角的业务日志条目。\ntype Event struct {\n\tAt      int64  `json:\"at\"`\n\tNode    int    `json:\"node\"`\n\tKind    string `json:\"kind\"` // send / recv / settle / release / drop_dup / insufficient\n\tPeer    int    `json:\"peer\"`\n\tAmount  int    `json:\"amount,omitempty\"`\n\tTxnID   int64  `json:\"txn_id,omitempty\"`\n\tBalance int    `json:\"balance\"`\n\tPending int    `json:\"pending,omitempty\"`\n\tNote    string `json:\"note,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Sender 把一条转账消息送入网络。\ntype Sender func(to, amount int, txn int64)\n\n// Node 是一个银行网点节点。\ntype Node struct {\n\tid      int\n\tbalance int\n\ttxnSeq  int64\n\tpending map[int]int // 各出方向已发起、尚未划出的金额\n\tseenTxn map[int64]bool\n\tsend    Sender\n\tlog     func(Event)\n}\n\n// New 创建节点。\nfunc New(id, balance int, send Sender, log func(Event)) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{\n\t\tid:      id,\n\t\tbalance: balance,\n\t\tpending: map[int]int{},\n\t\tseenTxn: map[int64]bool{},\n\t\tsend:    send,\n\t\tlog:     log,\n\t}\n}\n\n// ID 返回节点编号。\nfunc (n *Node) ID() int { return n.id }\n\n// Balance 返回已落定余额。\nfunc (n *Node) Balance() int { return n.balance }\n\n// TotalPending 返回所有出方向 pending 金额合计。\nfunc (n *Node) TotalPending() int {\n\tt := 0\n\tfor _, v := range n.pending {\n\t\tt += v\n\t}\n\treturn t\n}\n\n// Transfer 发起一笔向 to 的转账：挂 pending、发消息，暂不动 balance。余额不足返回 false。\nfunc (n *Node) Transfer(to, amount int, at int64) bool {\n\tif amount <= 0 {\n\t\tpanic(fmt.Sprintf(\"bank: 转账金额必须为正: %d\", amount))\n\t}\n\tif amount > n.balance-n.TotalPending() {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"insufficient\", Peer: to, Amount: amount,\n\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Pending: n.TotalPending()})\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tn.txnSeq++\n\ttxn := n.txnSeq\n\tn.pending[to] += amount\n\tn.send(to, 处理一条投递到本节点的转账。dup 表示网络重复副本。\nfunc (n *Node) Receive(from int, amount int, txn int64, at int64, dup bool) {\n\tif n.seenTxn[txn] {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"drop_dup\", Peer: from, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn,\n\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Note: \"重复转账，已忽略\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tn.seenTxn[txn] = true\n\tn.balance += amount\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"recv\", Peer: from, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn, Balance: n.balance})\n}\n\n// RecordState 在节点为快照 snapID 记录本地状态的同一刻调用：\n// 把当前全部出方向 pending 划出，返回记录下来的状态。幂等（同一 snapID 只结算一次）。\nfunc (n *Node) RecordState(snapID int, at int64) State {\n\tif n.settledSnap(snapID) {\n\t\treturn State{Balance: n.balance}\n\t}\n\tn.markSettled(snapID)\n\n\tpendingTotal := n.TotalPending()\n\tif pendingTotal > 0 {\n\t\tn.balance -= {"parentUuid":"c66b899b-cf74-42a4-9325-90644445d008","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_sec7j3kmlltkmmxm402oz48z","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp30/b/internal/snap/manager.go","content":"// Package snap 实现 Chandy–Lamport 分布式快照算法。\n//\n// 前提（见论文条件）：\n//   - 信道可靠且 FIFO：标记与业务消息走同一信道，标记不会越过业务消息；\n//   - 节点收到某快照的第一个标记时：记录自身状态，并沿所有出信道发送该快照标记；\n//   - 节点在“已记录状态”到“收到来自某邻居的标记”之间收到的业务消息，\n//     全部记入该入信道的在途消息；\n//\n// 多个快照 ID 可以同时交叠进行，彼此状态完全隔离。\npackage snap\n\nimport (\n\t\"sort\"\n\n\t\"simsnap/internal/msg\"\n)\n\n// MarkerSender 负责把快照标记真正送入网络（由应用层注入，避免本包依赖网络实现）。\ntype MarkerSender func(from, to, snapID int)\n\n// StateOf 在节点 node 为快照 snapID 记录本地状态的同一刻返回待记录的状态。\n// 应用层应在此回调中完成“记录时刻在途出账”的账务结算（见 bank 包）。\ntype StateOf func(node, snapID int, at int64) any\n\n// OnMarker 在节点收到某入信道标记、该信道在途记录关闭之后回调（参数：node 收信方, from 发信方）。\n// 应用层可借此释放与该方向对应的记账槽位。\ntype OnMarker func(node, from, snapID int, at int64)\n\n// NodeState 是一个节点记录下来的本地状态。\ntype NodeState struct {\n\tNode    int   `json:\"node\"`\n\tState   any   `json:\"state\"`\n\tTakenAt int64 `json:\"taken_at\"`\n}\n\n// ChannelState 是一条有向信道在快照中的记录。\ntype ChannelState struct {\n\tFrom   int           `json:\"from\"`\n\tTo     int           `json:\"to\"`\n\tMsgs   []msg.Message `json:\"msgs\"`\n\tClosed bool          `json:\"closed\"`\n}\n\n// Snapshot 是一次全局快照（可能尚未完成）。\ntype Snapshot struct {\n\tID           int            `json:\"id\"`\n\tComplete     bool           `json:\"complete\"`\n\tCompleteAt   int64          `json:\"complete_at,omitempty\"`\n\tNodes        []NodeState    `json:\"nodes\"`        // 已记录状态的节点（按节点号排序）\n\tChannels     []ChannelState `json:\"channels\"`     // 在记录窗口内捕到过消息的入信道\n\tMissingNodes []int          `json:\"missing_nodes,omitempty\"`\n\tOpenChannels [][2]int       `json:\"open_channels,omitempty\"` // 尚未关闭的入信道\n}\n\ntype chanRec struct {\n\tmsgs     []msg.Message\n\tclosed   bool\n\tclosedAt int64\n}\n\ntype nodeRec struct {\n\tdone    bool\n\tstate   any\n\ttakenAt int64\n\tin      map[int]*chanRec // in[peer] = 信道 peer->本节点 的记录\n}\n\ntype snapState struct {\n\tid         int\n\tnodes      map[int]*nodeRec\n\tcomplete   bool\n\tcompleteAt int64\n}\n\n// Manager 管理若干个交叠进行的快照，所有方法仅在单线程事件循环中调用。\ntype Manager struct {\n\tn          int\n\tsnaps      map[int]*snapState\n\tsendMarker MarkerSender\n\tstateOf    StateOf\n\tonMarker   OnMarker\n}\n\n// NewManager 创建快照管理器。n 为节点数（节点编号 0..n-1，全互联拓扑）。\nfunc NewManager(n int, sendMarker MarkerSender, stateOf StateOf, onMarker OnMarker) *Manager {\n\tif onMarker == nil {\n\t\tonMarker = func(int, int, int, int64) {}\n\t}\n\treturn &Manager{n: n, snaps: map[int]*snapState{}, sendMarker: sendMarker, stateOf: stateOf, onMarker: onMarker}\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) getOrCreate(id int) *snapState {\n\ts := m.snaps[id]\n\tif s == nil {\n\t\ts = &snapState{id: id, nodes: map[int]*nodeRec{}}\n\t\tm.snaps[id] = s\n\t}\n\treturn s\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) nodeRec(s *snapState, node int) *nodeRec {\n\tr := s.nodes[node]\n\tif r == nil {\n\t\tr = &nodeRec{in: map[int]*chanRec{}}\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif j != node {\n\t\t\t\tr.in[j] = &chanRec{}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\ts.nodes[node] = r\n\t}\n\treturn r\n}\n\n// Initiate 由发起节点启动一次快照（幂等：重复 ID 不会重入）。返回 false 表示该 ID 已存在。\nfunc (m *Manager) Initiate(id int, initiator int, at int64) bool {\n\tif _, ok := m.snaps[id]; ok {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\ts := m.getOrCreate(id)\n\tm.recordState(s, initiator, at)\n\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\tif j != initiator {\n\t\t\tm.sendMarker(initiator, j, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) recordState(s *snapState, node int, at int64) {\n\tr := m.nodeRec(s, node)\n\tif r.done {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tr.done = true\n\tr.state = m.stateOf(node, s.id, at)\n\tr.takenAt = at\n}\n\n// MarkerReceived 处理 node 收到来自 from 的快照标记。\nfunc (m *Manager) MarkerReceived(id, from, node int, at int64) {\n\ts := m.getOrCreate(id)\n\tr := m.nodeRec(s, node)\n\tif !r.done {\n\t\t// 第一个标记：同一刻记录本地状态，再向所有出信道转发标记。\n\t\tm.recordState(s, node, at)\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif j != node {\n\t\t\t\tm.sendMarker(node, j, id)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif ch := r.in[from]; ch != nil && !ch.closed {\n\t\tch.closed = true\n\t\tch.closedAt = at\n\t}\n\tm.onMarker(node, from, id, at)\n\tm.checkComplete(s, at)\n}\n\n// DataReceived 在 node 处理一条业务消息【之前】调用：\n// 若 node 已为某快照记录状态、且来自 from 的信道尚未关闭，则该消息属于该快照的在途消息。\n// 返回该消息被哪些快照捕获（升序，保证确定性）。\nfunc (m *Manager) DataReceived(from, node int, message msg.Message) []int {\n\tvar captured []int\n\tfor _, id := range m.activeIDs(node) {\n\t\ts := m.snaps[id]\n\t\tr := s.nodes[node]\n\t\tch := r.in[from]\n\t\tif ch != nil && !ch.closed {\n\t\t\tch.msgs = append(ch.msgs, message)\n\t\t\tcaptured = append(captured, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn captured\n}\n\n// activeIDs 返回 node 已记录状态、但全局尚未完成的快照 ID（升序）。\nfunc (m *Manager) activeIDs(node int) []int {\n\tids := make([]int, 0)\n\tfor id, s := range m.snaps {\n\t\tif s.complete {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r := s.nodes[node]; r != nil && r.done {\n\t\t\tids = append(ids, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Ints(ids)\n\treturn ids\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) checkComplete(s *snapState, at int64) {\n\tif s.complete || len(s.nodes) != m.n {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tfor i := 0; i < m.n; i++ {\n\t\tr := s.nodes[i]\n\t\tif r == nil || !r.done {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif j != i {\n\t\t\t\tif ch := r.in[j]; ch == nil || !ch.closed {\n\t\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\ts.complete = true\n\ts.completeAt = at\n}\n\n// IsComplete 报告某快照是否已完成。\nfunc (m *Manager) IsComplete(id int) bool {\n\tif s := m.snaps[id]; s != nil {\n\t\treturn s.complete\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// CompletedIDs 返回所有已完成快照 ID（升序）。\nfunc (m *Manager) CompletedIDs() []int {\n\tvar ids []int\n\tfor id, s := range m.snaps {\n\t\tif s.complete {\n\t\t\tids = append(ids, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Ints(ids)\n\treturn ids\n}\n\n// Build 生成某快照的可序列化报告（无论是否完成都可调用）。\n// 只输出在记录窗口内捕到过消息的信道；空信道隐含“无在途消息”，避免 N×N 的零值噪声。\nfunc (m *Manager) Build(id int) Snapshot {\n\ts := m.snaps[id]\n\tout := Snapshot{ID: id}\n\tif s == nil {\n\t\treturn out\n\t}\n\tout.Complete = s.complete\n\tout.CompleteAt = s.completeAt\n\n\tnodeIDs := make([]int, 0, len(s.nodes))\n\tfor i := range s.nodes {\n\t\tnodeIDs = append(nodeIDs, i)\n\t}\n\tsort.Ints(nodeIDs)\n\tfor _, i := range nodeIDs {\n\t\tr := s.nodes[i]\n\t\tif r.done {\n\t\t\tout.Nodes = append(out.Nodes, NodeState{Node: i, State: r.state, TakenAt: r.takenAt})\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tout.MissingNodes = append(out.MissingNodes, i)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Ints(out.MissingNodes)\n\n\tfor b := 0; b < m.n; b++ {\n\t\tr := s.nodes[b]\n\t\tif r == nil {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tpeers := make([]int, 0, len(r.in))\n\t\tfor a := range r.in {\n\t\t\tpeers = append(peers, a)\n\t\t}\n\t\tsort.Ints(peers)\n\t\tfor _, a := range peers {\n\t\t\tch := r.in[a]\n\t\t\tif len(ch.msgs) == 0 {\n\t\t\t\tif !ch.closed {\n\t\t\t\t\tout.OpenChannels = append(out.OpenChannels, [2]int{a, b})\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tcs := ChannelState{From: a, To: b, Closed: ch.closed, Msgs: append([]msg.Message(nil), ch.msgs...)}\n\t\t\tif !ch.closed {\n\t\t\t\tout.OpenChannels = append(out.OpenChannels, [2]int{a, b})\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tout.Channels = append(out.Channels, cs)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_3c9764b1b50e949cd2b43d42","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2114,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":102200,"output_tokens":2780,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_sec7j3kmlltkmmxm402oz48z":{"content":"// func(from, to, snapID int)\n\n// StateOf 在节点 node 为快照 snapID 记录本地状态的同一刻返回待记录的状态。\n// 应用层应在此回调中完成“记录时刻在途出账”的账务结算（见 bank 包）。\ntype StateOf func(node, snapID int, at int64) any\n\n// OnMarker 在节点收到某入信道标记、该信道在途记录关闭之后回调（参数：node 收信方, from 发信方）。\n// 应用层可借此释放与该方向对应的记账槽位。\ntype OnMarker func(node, from, snapID int, at int64)\n\n// NodeState 是一个节点记录下来的本地状态。\ntype NodeState struct {\n\tNode    int   `json:\"node\"`\n\tState   any   `json:\"state\"`\n\tTakenAt int64 `json:\"taken_at\"`\n}\n\n// ChannelState 是一条有向信道在快照中的记录。\ntype ChannelState struct {\n\tFrom   int           `json:\"from\"`\n\tTo     int           `json:\"to\"`\n\tMsgs   []msg.Message `json:\"msgs\"`\n\tClosed bool          `json:\"closed\"`\n}\n\n// Snapshot 是一次全局快照（可能尚未完成）。\ntype Snapshot struct {\n\tID           int            `json:\"id\"`\n\tComplete     bool           `json:\"complete\"`\n\tCompleteAt   int64          `json:\"complete_at,omitempty\"`\n\tNodes        []NodeState    `json:\"nodes\"`        // 已记录状态的节点（按节点号排序）\n\tChannels     []ChannelState `json:\"channels\"`     // 在记录窗口内捕到过消息的入信道\n\tMissingNodes []int          `json:\"missing_nodes,omitempty\"`\n\tOpenChannels [][2]int       `json:\"open_channels,omitempty\"` // 尚未关闭的入信道\n}\n\ntype chanRec struct {\n\tmsgs     []msg.Message\n\tclosed   bool\n\tclosedAt int64\n}\n\ntype nodeRec struct {\n\tdone    bool\n\tstate   any\n\ttakenAt int64\n\tin      map[int]*chanRec // in[peer] = 信道 peer->本节点 的记录\n}\n\ntype snapState struct {\n\tid         int\n\tnodes      map[int]*nodeRec\n\tcomplete   bool\n\tcompleteAt int64\n}\n\n// Manager 管理若干个交叠进行的快照，所有方法仅在单线程事件循环中调用。\ntype Manager struct {\n\tn          int\n\tsnaps      map[int]*snapState\n\tsendMarker MarkerSender\n\tstateOf    StateOf\n\tonMarker *nodeRec {\n\tr := s.nodes[node]\n\tif r == nil {\n\t\tr = &nodeRec{in: map[int]*chanRec{}}\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif j != node {\n\t\t\t\tr.in[j] = {\n\t\t\tch.msgs = append(ch.msgs, message)\n\t\t\tcaptured = append(captured, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn captured\n}\n\n// activeIDs 返回 node 已记录状态、但全局尚未完成的快照 ID（升序）。\nfunc (m *Manager) activeIDs(node int) []int {\n\tids := make([]int, 0)\n\tfor id, s := range m.snaps {\n\t\tif s.complete {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r := s.nodes[node]; r != nil && r.done {\n\t\t\tids = append(ids, {\n\t\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\ts.complete = true\n\ts.completeAt = at\n}\n\n// IsComplete 报告某快照是否已完成。\nfunc (m *Manager) IsComplete(id int) bool {\n\tif s := m.snaps[id]; s != {\n\t\t\tids = append(ids, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Ints(ids)\n\treturn ids\n}\n\n// Build 生成某快照的可序列化报告（无论是否完成都可调用）。\n// 只输出在记录窗口内捕到过消息的信道；空信道隐含“无在途消息”，避免 N×N 的零值噪声。\nfunc (m *Manager) Build(id int) Snapshot {\n\ts := m.snaps[id]\n\tout := Snapshot{ID: id}\n\tif s == nil {\n\t\treturn out\n\t}\n\tout.Complete = s.complete\n\tout.CompleteAt = s.completeAt\n\n\tnodeIDs := make([]int, 0, }"]}],"originalFile":"// Package snap 实现 Chandy–Lamport 分布式快照算法。\n//\n// 前提（见论文条件）：\n//   - 信道可靠且 FIFO：标记与业务消息走同一信道，标记不会越过业务消息；\n//   - 节点收到某快照的第一个标记时：记录自身状态，并沿所有出信道发送该快照标记；\n//   - 节点在“已记录状态”到“收到来自某邻居的标记”之间收到的业务消息，\n//     全部记入该入信道的在途消息；\n//\n// 多个快照 ID 可以同时交叠进行，彼此状态完全隔离。\n//\n// 与“发起即扣款”银行模型的配套补记：\n// 节点记录状态时，此前发起的转账可能还没到对端。若它在对端记录状态之前到达，\n// 钱已进对端余额；若在对端标记截止【之后】才到达，则它既不在发起方状态\n// （发起方已扣款）也不在对端状态/在途记录中。Build 时依据消息的发送/投递时刻\n// 把这部分金额补记为发起方状态的 out_after 字段，保证全局切面每笔钱唯一归属一次。\npackage snap\n\nimport (\n\t\"sort\"\n\n\t\"simsnap/internal/msg\"\n)\n\n// MarkerSender 负责把快照标记真正送入网络（由应用层注入，避免本包依赖网络实现）。\ntype MarkerSender func(from, to, snapID int)\n\n// StateOf 返回节点当前待记录的状态（由应用层注入；可以是任意可序列化值）。\n// 若返回值实现了 SnapshotState 接口，Build 会用 SetOutAfter 写入补记金额。\ntype StateOf func(node int) any\n\n// SnapshotState 由可接收 out_after 补记的状态实现。\ntype SnapshotState interface {\n\tSetOutAfter(amount int)\n}\n\n// NodeState 是一个节点记录下来的本地状态。\ntype NodeState struct {\n\tNode    int   `json:\"node\"`\n\tState   any   `json:\"state\"`\n\tTakenAt int64 `json:\"taken_at\"`\n}\n\n// ChannelState 是一条有向信道在快照中的记录。\ntype ChannelState struct {\n\tFrom   int           `json:\"from\"`\n\tTo     int           `json:\"to\"`\n\tMsgs   []msg.Message `json:\"msgs\"`\n\tClosed bool          `json:\"closed\"`\n}\n\n// Snapshot 是一次全局快照（可能尚未完成）。\ntype Snapshot struct {\n\tID           int            `json:\"id\"`\n\tComplete     bool           `json:\"complete\"`\n\tCompleteAt   int64          `json:\"complete_at,omitempty\"`\n\tNodes        []NodeState    `json:\"nodes\"`        // 已记录状态的节点（按节点号排序）\n\tChannels     []ChannelState `json:\"channels\"`     // 在记录窗口内捕到过消息的入信道（按 to,from 排序）\n\tMissingNodes []int          `json:\"missing_nodes,omitempty\"`\n\tOpenChannels [][2]int       `json:\"open_channels,omitempty\"` // 尚未关闭的入信道\n}\n\ntype chanRec struct {\n\tmsgs    []msg.Message\n\tclosed  bool\n\tclosedAt int64 // 入信道收到标记、记录截止的时刻\n}\n\ntype nodeRec struct {\n\tdone    bool\n\tstate   any\n\ttakenAt int64\n\tin      map[int]*chanRec // in[peer] = 信道 peer->本节点 的记录\n}\n\ntype snapState struct {\n\tid         int\n\tnodes      map[int]*nodeRec\n\tcomplete   bool\n\tcompleteAt int64\n}\n\n// deliveredMsg 记录一条业务消息的发送与实际投递时刻。\ntype deliveredMsg struct {\n\tm       msg.Message\n\tarrived int64 // 0 表示快照完成时尚未到达\n}\n\n// Manager 管理若干个交叠进行的快照，所有方法仅在单线程事件循环中调用。\ntype Manager struct {\n\tn          int\n\tsnaps      map[int]*snapState\n\tsendMarker MarkerSender\n\tstateOf    StateOf\n\tdelivered  []deliveredMsg\n}\n\n// NewManager 创建快照管理器。n 为节点数（节点编号 0..n-1，全互联拓扑）。\nfunc NewManager(n int, sendMarker MarkerSender, stateOf StateOf) *Manager {\n\treturn &Manager{n: n, snaps: map[int]*snapState{}, sendMarker: sendMarker, stateOf: stateOf}\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) getOrCreate(id int) *snapState {\n\ts := m.snaps[id]\n\tif s == nil {\n\t\t// 标记可能先于“本地发起”事件到达（发起节点在别处），惰性建立记录。\n\t\ts = &snapState{id: id, nodes: map[int]*nodeRec{}}\n\t\tm.snaps[id] = s\n\t}\n\treturn s\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) nodeRec(s *snapState, node int) *nodeRec {\n\tr := s.nodes[node]\n\tif r == nil {\n\t\tr = &nodeRec{in: map[int]*chanRec{}}\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif j != node {\n\t\t\t\tr.in[j] = &chanRec{}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\ts.nodes[node] = r\n\t}\n\treturn r\n}\n\n// Initiate 由发起节点启动一次快照（幂等：重复 ID 不会重入）。返回 false 表示该 ID 已存在。\nfunc (m *Manager) Initiate(id int, initiator int, at int64) bool {\n\tif _, ok := m.snaps[id]; ok {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\ts := m.getOrCreate(id)\n\tm.recordState(s, initiator, at)\n\t// 记录状态后，沿所有出信道发送标记。\n\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\tif j != initiator {\n\t\t\tm.sendMarker(initiator, j, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) recordState(s *snapState, node int, at int64) {\n\tr := m.nodeRec(s, node)\n\tif r.done {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tr.done = true\n\tr.state = m.stateOf(node)\n\tr.takenAt = at\n}\n\n// MarkerReceived 处理 node 收到来自 from 的快照标记。\nfunc (m *Manager) MarkerReceived(id, from, node int, at int64) {\n\ts := m.getOrCreate(id)\n\tr := m.nodeRec(s, node)\n\tfirst := !r.done\n\tif first {\n\t\t// 规则：收到第一个标记的瞬间记录本地状态，再向所有出信道转发标记。\n\t\tm.recordState(s, node, at)\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif j != node {\n\t\t\t\tm.sendMarker(node, j, id)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// 规则：收到标记 => 入信道 from->node 的在途消息记录截止。\n\tif ch := r.in[from]; ch != nil && !ch.closed {\n\t\tch.closed = true\n\t\tch.closedAt = at\n\t}\n\tm.checkComplete(s, at)\n}\n\n// NoteSend 记录一条业务消息的发送（按 TxnID 去重）。\nfunc (m *Manager) NoteSend(message msg.Message) {\n\tfor _, d := range m.delivered {\n\t\tif d.m.TxnID == message.TxnID && d.m.From == message.From {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tm.delivered = append(m.delivered, deliveredMsg{m: message})\n}\n\n// NoteDelivery 补记一条已发送消息的实际投递到达时刻（重复副本只记第一次）。\nfunc (m *Manager) NoteDelivery(message msg.Message, arrivedAt int64) {\n\tfor i := range m.delivered {\n\t\td := &m.delivered[i]\n\t\tif d.m.TxnID == message.TxnID && d.m.From == message.From {\n\t\t\tif d.arrived == 0 {\n\t\t\t\td.arrived = arrivedAt\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// 未先记录发送（防御性）：直接补登记。\n\tm.delivered = append(m.delivered, deliveredMsg{m: message, arrived: arrivedAt})\n}\n\n// DataReceived 在 node 处理一条业务消息【之前】调用：\n// 若 node 已为某快照记录状态、且来自 from 的信道尚未关闭，则该消息属于该快照的在途消息。\n// 返回该消息被哪些快照捕获（升序，保证确定性）。\nfunc (m *Manager) DataReceived(from, node int, message msg.Message) []int {\n\tvar captured []int\n\tfor _, id := range m.activeIDs(node) {\n\t\ts := m.snaps[id]\n\t\tr := s.nodes[node]\n\t\tch := r.in[from] // in 的键是对端节点；from 即入信道的发送方\n\t\tif ch != nil && !ch.closed {\n\t\t\tch.msgs = append(ch.msgs, message)\n\t\t\tcaptured = append(captured, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn captured\n}\n\n// activeIDs 返回 node 已记录状态、但全局尚未完成的快照 ID（升序，保证确定性）。\nfunc (m *Manager) activeIDs(node int) []int {\n\tids := make([]int, 0)\n\tfor id, s := range m.snaps {\n\t\tif s.complete {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r := s.nodes[node]; r != nil && r.done {\n\t\t\tids = append(ids, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Ints(ids)\n\treturn ids\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) checkComplete(s *snapState, at int64) {\n\tif s.complete {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif len(s.nodes) != m.n {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tfor i := 0; i < m.n; i++ {\n\t\tr := s.nodes[i]\n\t\tif r == nil || !r.done {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif j == i {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif ch := r.in[j]; ch == nil || !ch.closed {\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\ts.complete = true\n\ts.completeAt = at\n}\n\n// IsComplete 报告某快照是否已完成。\nfunc (m *Manager) IsComplete(id int) bool {\n\tif s := m.snaps[id]; s != nil {\n\t\treturn s.complete\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// CompletedIDs 返回所有已完成快照 ID（升序）。\nfunc (m *Manager) CompletedIDs() []int {\n\tvar ids []int\n\tfor id, s := range m.snaps {\n\t\tif s.complete {\n\t\t\tids = append(ids, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Ints(ids)\n\treturn ids\n}\n\n// OutAfter 返回某快照中某节点“记录前发出、既未进入对端状态也未进入在途记录”\n// 的金额合计：消息在发起方记录之前发出（发起方余额已扣），但晚于对端入信道\n// 标记截止才到达，因此按 CL 切面补记为发起方状态的一部分。\nfunc (m *Manager) OutAfter(snapID, node int) int {\n\ts := m.snaps[snapID]\n\tif s == nil {\n\t\treturn 0\n\t}\n\tr := s.nodes[node]\n\tif r == nil || !r.done {\n\t\treturn 0\n\t}\n\ttotal := 0\n\tfor _, d := range m.delivered {\n\t\tmm := d.m\n\t\tif mm.From != node || mm.SentAt >= r.takenAt {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tpeer := s.nodes[mm.To]\n\t\tif peer == nil || !peer.done {\n\t\t\tcontinue // 对端尚未记录（快照未完成），无法判定\n\t\t}\n\t\tch := peer.in[node]\n\t\tif ch == nil {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\t// 到达不晚于入信道标记截止时刻：要么已进对端余额（< takenAt），\n\t\t// 要么已被在途记录捕获（takenAt..closedAt 窗口内）。\n\t\t// 严格晚于 closedAt，或快照完成时尚未到达（arrived==0），\n\t\t// 都属于“截止时仍在途、且不归入任何在途信道”的钱，补记到发起方。\n\t\tif d.arrived != 0 && d.arrived <= ch.closedAt {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\ttotal += mm.Amount\n\t}\n\treturn total\n}\n\n// Build 生成某快照的可序列化报告（无论是否完成都可调用）。\n// 只输出在记录窗口内捕到过消息的信道；空信道隐含“无在途消息”，避免 N×N 的零值噪声。\nfunc (m *Manager) Build(id int) Snapshot {\n\ts := m.snaps[id]\n\tout := Snapshot{ID: id}\n\tif s == nil {\n\t\treturn out\n\t}\n\tout.Complete = s.complete\n\tout.CompleteAt = s.completeAt\n\n\tnodeIDs := make([]int, 0, len(s.nodes))\n\tfor i := range s.nodes {\n\t\tnodeIDs = append(nodeIDs, i)\n\t}\n\tsort.Ints(nodeIDs)\n\tfor _, i := range nodeIDs {\n\t\tr := s.nodes[i]\n\t\tif r.done {\n\t\t\tstate := r.state\n\t\t\tif s.complete {\n\t\t\t\tif sa, ok := state.(SnapshotState); ok {\n\t\t\t\t\tsa.SetOutAfter(m.OutAfter(id, i))\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tout.Nodes = append(out.Nodes, NodeState{Node: i, State: state, TakenAt: r.takenAt})\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tout.MissingNodes = append(out.MissingNodes, i)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Ints(out.MissingNodes)\n\n\tfor b := 0; b < m.n; b++ {\n\t\tr := s.nodes[b]\n\t\tif r == nil {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tpeers := make([]int, 0, len(r.in))\n\t\tfor a := range r.in {\n\t\t\tpeers = append(peers, a)\n\t\t}\n\t\tsort.Ints(peers)\n\t\tfor _, a := range peers {\n\t\t\tch := r.in[a]\n\t\t\tif len(ch.msgs) == 0 {\n\t\t\t\tif !ch.closed {\n\t\t\t\t\tout.OpenChannels = append(out.OpenChannels, [2]int{a, b})\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tcs := ChannelState{From: a, To: b, Closed: ch.closed, Msgs: append([]msg.Message(nil), ch.msgs...)}\n\t\t\tif !ch.closed {\n\t\t\t\tout.OpenChannels = append(out.OpenChannels, [2]int{a, b})\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tout.Channels = append(out.Channels, cs)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn {"parentUuid":"074e6277-e33c-43cb-a8dc-224bf0077500","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"text":"等等——这个模型仍有双重/遗漏问题：记录后才发送的钱已从 balance 扣除（在 settle 之后发的新转账，按当前代码仍挂 pending 不扣），会同时缺记。让我彻底推导后再定，先用一个微型纸笔验证。关键不变式：**记录时刻 S 的全局状态 = 各节点（balance - 记录后将划出的 pending 部分）+ 各在途信道消息**。\n\n正确规则是：\n- 转账发起：**立即扣 balance**，钱在网络上（经典 CL 银行就是这样，balance 是\"可用余额\"）；\n- 记录状态：balance 原样记录；\n- 在途补记完全由管理器的信道消息记录承担——记录前发出、截止后才到的消息由**发起方的 outgoing 集合**负责。\n\n让我重新严谨地按原论文表述实现，论文中节点状态显式包含所有信道的输入输出。\n","type":"text"}],"id":"msg_1050d262edd5d35643f10abe","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2681,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":106296,"output_tokens":312,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"apiBlockIndex":1,"type":"assistant","uuid":"4056439d-1e88-4f3b-9010-f4aa60f45f39","timestamp":"2026-09-23T06:13:17.268Z","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp30/b","sessionId":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp30-b","slug":"glimmering-hopping-papert"}

是时间线日志条目。\ntype LogEvent struct {\n\tAt       int64  `json:\"at\"`\n\tKind     string `json:\"kind\"`\n\tSnapID   int    `json:\"snap_id,omitempty\"`\n\tFrom     int    `json:\"from,omitempty\"`\n\tTo SnapshotResult struct {\n\tSnapshot snap.Snapshot `json:\"snapshot\"`\n\tNodeSum  int           `json:\"node_sum\"`  // 记录状态中余额之和\n\tInFlight int           `json:\"in_flight\"` // 在途转账金额之和\n\tTotal    int           `json:\"total\"`     // node_sum + in_flight\n\tExpected int           `json:\"expected\"`  // 初始总余额（守恒参照）\n\tConserved bool         `json:\"conserved\"` // complete && total == expected\n}\n\n// BalanceEntry 是结束时某节点余额。\ntype BalanceEntry struct {\n\tNode    int `json:\"node\"`\n\tBalance int `json:\"balance\"`\n}\n\n// LinkStat 是一条有向信道的结束统计。\ntype LinkStat struct {\n\tFrom  int       `json:\"from\"`\n\tTo    int       `json:\"to\"`\n\tStats sim.Stats `json:\"stats\"`\n}\n\n// Response 是一次模拟运行的输出。\ntype Response struct {\n\tSeed            int64            `json:\"seed\"`\n\tNow             int64            `json:\"now\"`\n\tDeadline        int64            `json:\"deadline\"`\n\tInitialTotal    int              `json:\"initial_total\"`\n\tFinalBalances   []BalanceEntry   `json:\"final_balances\"`\n\tFinalTotal      int              `json:\"final_total\"`\n\tSnapshots       []SnapshotResult `json:\"snapshots\"`\n\tNetwork         []LinkStat       `json:\"network\"`\n\tEvents          []LogEvent       `json:\"events\"`\n\tStoppedDeadline bool             `json:\"stopped_by_deadline,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Run 执行请求并返回结果。请求必须已通过 Validate。\nfunc Run(r *Request) *Response {\n\tn := len(r.Balances)\n\teng := sim.NewEngine(r.Seed)\n\tif r.Deadline > 0 {\n\t\teng.SetDeadline(r.Deadline)\n\t}\n\tnetw := sim.NewNetwork(eng)\n\tpolicies, _ := r.Validate()\n\tfor a := 0; a < n; a++ {\n\t\tfor b := a + 1; b < n; b++ {\n\t\t\tnetw.AddLink(a, b, policies[pairKey(a, b)])\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tevents := []LogEvent{}\n\tlogf := func(e LogEvent) { events = append(events, e) }\n\n\tnodes := make([]*bank.Node, n)\n\tvar mgr *snap.Manager\n\tlogComplete := func(id int, at int64) {\n\t\tif mgr == nil || !mgr.IsComplete(id) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor _, e := range events {\n\t\t\tif e.Kind == EvComplete && e.SnapID == id {\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tbs := make([]int, n)\n\t\tfor i, nd := range nodes {\n\t\t\tbs[i] = nd.Balance()\n\t\t}\n\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: at, Kind: EvComplete, SnapID: id, Balances: bs})\n\t}\n\n\tvar send func(m msg.Message)\n\tsend = func(m msg.Message) {\n\t\tnetw.Send(m, func(d sim.Delivery) {\n\t\t\tmm := d.Msg\n\t\t\tif mm.IsMarker() {\n\t\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: d.At, Kind: EvMarkerDeliver, SnapID: mm.SnapID,\n\t\t\t\t\tFrom: mm.From, To: mm.To, SendID: d.SendID, Dup: d.Dup})\n\t\t\t\tif !d.Dup {\n\t\t\t\t\tmgr.MarkerReceived(mm.SnapID, mm.From, mm.To, d.At)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tlogComplete(mm.SnapID, d.At)\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: d.At, Kind: EvDeliver, From: mm.From, To: mm.To,\n\t\t\t\tAmount: mm.Amount, TxnID: mm.TxnID, SendID: d.SendID, Dup: d.Dup})\n\t\t\t// Chandy–Lamport：先让快照管理器判定在途归属，再执行业务状态变更。\n\t\t\tcaptured := mgr.DataReceived(mm.From, mm.To, mm)\n\t\t\tfor _, sid := range captured {\n\t\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: d.At, Kind: EvCaptured, SnapID: sid, From: mm.From, To: mm.To,\n\t\t\t\t\tAmount: mm.Amount, TxnID: mm.TxnID})\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tnodes[mm.To].Receive(mm.From, mm.Amount, mm.TxnID, d.At, d.Dup)\n\t\t})\n\t\tkind := EvSend\n\t\tif m.IsMarker() {\n\t\t\tkind = EvMarkerSend\n\t\t}\n\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: eng.Now(), Kind: kind, SnapID: m.SnapID, From: m.From, To: m.To,\n\t\t\tAmount: m.Amount, TxnID: m.TxnID})\n\t}\n\tfor i := 0; i < n; i++ {\n\t\ti := i\n\t\tnodes[i] = bank.New(i, r.Balances[i],\n\t\t\tfunc(to, amount int, txn int64) {\n\t\t\t\tsend(msg.Message{Kind: msg.Data, From: i, To: to, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn})\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tfunc(ev bank.Event) {\n\t\t\t\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\t\t\t\tcase \"insufficient\":\n\t\t\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: ev.At, Kind: EvInsufficient, From: ev.Node, To: ev.Peer,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tAmount: ev.Amount, Note: ev.Note})\n\t\t\t\tcase \"drop_dup\":\n\t\t\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: ev.At, Kind: EvDropDup, From: ev.Node, To: ev.Peer,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tAmount: ev.Amount, TxnID: ev.TxnID, Note: ev.Note})\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t})\n\t}\n\n\tstateOf := func(node, snapID int, at int64) any {\n\t\t// 记录本地状态的同一刻：节点把当前 pending 划出并记入状态。\n\t\tst := nodes[node].RecordState(snapID, at)\n\t\treturn &st\n\t}\n\tmgr = snap.NewManager(n,\n\t\tfunc(from, to, snapID int) {\n\t\t\tsend(msg.Message{Kind: msg.Marker, SnapID: snapID, From: from, To: to})\n\t\t},\n\t\tstateOf,\n\t\tfunc(node, from, snapID {"parentUuid":"06915b83-acdb-4d7c-af48-f85196756c2e","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_ya98p37r9wmesf390ad5ho0d","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp30/b/internal/bank/node.go","content":"// Package bank 实现 Chandy–Lamport 原论文中的“转账守恒模型”节点。\n//\n// 教科书式银行语义，任意时刻（无丢包）恒有：\n//\n//\tΣ 节点 balance + Σ 网络中未入账的在途转账金额 = 初始总额\n//\n//   - 发起转账：立即从 balance 扣款，消息进入网络（钱在途中）；\n//   - 收款方：收到转账即入账；\n//   - 重复投递：按 TxnID 幂等去重，不重复入账。\n//\n// 快照守恒由 Chandy–Lamport 算法本身保证：节点记录的本地状态是当时余额；\n// “记录时刻已在途中”的消息由快照管理器依据发送日志归入某一方（收款方在途\n// 信道或发起方状态的补记），应用层无需在节点账务里做特殊处理。\npackage bank\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n)\n\n// State 是快照记录的节点状态。\ntype State struct {\n\tBalance int `json:\"balance\"`\n}\n\n// Event 是节点视角的业务日志条目。\ntype Event struct {\n\tAt      int64  `json:\"at\"`\n\tNode    int    `json:\"node\"`\n\tKind    string `json:\"kind\"` // send / recv / drop_dup / insufficient\n\tPeer    int    `json:\"peer\"`\n\tAmount  int    `json:\"amount,omitempty\"`\n\tTxnID   int64  `json:\"txn_id,omitempty\"`\n\tBalance int    `json:\"balance\"`\n\tNote    string `json:\"note,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Sender 把一条转账消息送入网络。\ntype Sender func(to, amount int, txn int64)\n\n// Node 是一个银行网点节点。\ntype Node struct {\n\tid      int\n\tbalance int\n\ttxnSeq  int64\n\tseenTxn map[int64]bool\n\tsend    Sender\n\tlog     func(Event)\n}\n\n// New 创建节点。\nfunc New(id, balance int, send Sender, log func(Event)) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{\n\t\tid:      id,\n\t\tbalance: balance,\n\t\tseenTxn: map[int64]bool{},\n\t\tsend:    send,\n\t\tlog:     log,\n\t}\n}\n\n// ID 返回节点编号。\nfunc (n *Node) ID() int { return n.id }\n\n// Balance 返回当前余额。\nfunc (n *Node) Balance() int { return n.balance }\n\n// SnapshotState 返回快照用的节点状态。\nfunc (n *Node) SnapshotState() any { return &State{Balance: n.balance} }\n\n// Transfer 发起一笔向 to State struct {\n\tBalance int `json:\"balance\"` // 记录时刻余额（当时 pending 已划出）\n\tPending int `json:\"pending\"` // 记录时刻划出的在途出账金额合计\n}\n\n// Event 是节点视角的业务日志条目。\ntype Event struct {\n\tAt      int64  `json:\"at\"`\n\tNode    int    `json:\"node\"`\n\tKind    string `json:\"kind\"` // send / recv / settle / drop_dup / insufficient\n\tPeer    int    `json:\"peer\"`\n\tAmount  int    `json:\"amount,omitempty\"`\n\tTxnID   int64  `json:\"txn_id,omitempty\"`\n\tBalance int    `json:\"balance\"`\n\tPending int    `json:\"pending,omitempty\"`\n\tNote    string `json:\"note,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Sender 把一条转账消息送入网络。\ntype Sender func(to, amount int, txn int64)\n\n// Node 是一个银行网点节点。\ntype Node struct {\n\tid          int\n\tbalance     int\n\ttxnSeq      int64\n\tpending     map[int]int // 各出方向已发起、尚未释放的金额\n\tsettledSnap map[int]bool\n\tseenTxn     map[int64]bool\n\tsend        Sender\n\tlog         func(Event)\n}\n\n// New 创建节点。\nfunc New(id, balance int, send Sender, log func(Event)) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{\n\t\tid:          id,\n\t\tbalance:     balance,\n\t\tpending:     map[int]int{},\n\t\tsettledSnap: map[int]bool{},\n\t\tseenTxn:     map[int64]bool{},\n\t\tsend:        send,\n\t\tlog:         log,\n\t}\n}\n\n// ID 返回节点编号。\nfunc (n *Node) ID() int { return n.id }\n\n// Balance 返回已落定余额（pending 金额在记录状态前仍包含在内）。\nfunc (n *Node) Balance() int { return n.balance }\n\n// TotalPending 返回所有出方向 pending 金额合计。\nfunc (n *Node) TotalPending() int {\n\tt := 0\n\tfor _, v := range n.pending {\n\t\tt += v\n\t}\n\treturn t\n}\n\n// Transfer 发起一笔向 to 的转账：挂 pending、发消息，暂不动 balance。可用不足返回 false。\nfunc (n *Node) Transfer(to, amount int, at int64) bool {\n\tif amount <= 0 {\n\t\tpanic(fmt.Sprintf(\"bank: 转账金额必须为正: %d\", amount))\n\t}\n\tif amount > n.balance-n.TotalPending() {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"insufficient\", Peer: to, Amount: amount,\n\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Pending: n.TotalPending()})\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tn.txnSeq++\n\ttxn := n.txnSeq\n\tn.pending[to] += amount\n\tn.send(to, amount, txn)\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"send\", Peer: to, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn,\n\t\tBalance: n.balance, Pending: n.TotalPending()})\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// Receive 处理一条投递到本节点的转账。dup 表示网络重复副本。\nfunc (n *Node) Receive(from int, amount int, txn int64, at int64, dup bool) {\n\tif n.seenTxn[txn] {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"drop_dup\", Peer: from, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn,\n\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Note: \"重复转账，已忽略\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tn.seenTxn[txn] = true\n\tn.balance += amount\n\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"recv\", Peer: from, Amount: amount, TxnID: txn, Balance: n.balance})\n}\n\n// RecordState 在节点为快照 snapID 记录本地状态的同一刻调用：\n// 把当前全部 pending 从 balance 划出，并返回记录状态（含划出额）。\n// 幂等：同一快照重复调用返回当时状态而不重复结算。\nfunc (n *Node) RecordState(snapID int, at int64) State {\n\tif n.settledSnap[snapID] {\n\t\treturn State{Balance: n.balance}\n\t}\n\tn.settledSnap[snapID] = true\n\n\tpendingTotal := n.TotalPending()\n\tif pendingTotal > 0 {\n\t\tn.balance -= pendingTotal\n\t\tpeers := make([]int, 0, len(n.pending))\n\t\tfor p, v := range n.pending {\n\t\t\tif v > 0 {\n\t\t\t\tpeers = append(peers, p)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tsort.Ints(peers)\n\t\tfor _, p := range peers {\n\t\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"settle\", Peer: p, Amount: n.pending[p],\n\t\t\t\tBalance: n.balance, Pending: n.TotalPending()})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn State{Balance: n.balance, Pending: pendingTotal}\n}\n\n// ReleaseInbound 在节点收到来自 peer 的快照标记时调用：\n// peer -> node 方向标记到达意味着 node 沿 node->peer 方向发出、在标记之前的消息\n// 都已送达并被对端处理，释放该方向的 pending 记账槽位（不再影响可用余额判断）。\nfunc (n *Node) ReleaseInbound(peer int) {\n\tn.pending[peer] = 0\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"35b43e65-8397-4930-a5ef-a37969b429fa","session_id":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp30/b","sessionId":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp30-b","slug":"glimmering-hopping-papert"}

{"parentUuid":"68efd037-ea42-4edd-8296-349e59f46cb1","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"text":"现在给管理器加上「发送日志」和完成时的正确归属判定。关键判定——一条消息对快照 S 归属哪一方：\n\n- 发送时刻 ≥ 发送方记录时刻 → 切面之后，忽略；\n- 发送时刻 < 发送方记录时刻（发送方已扣款）：\n  - 到达时刻 < 接收方记录时刻 → 已在接收方余额；\n  - 到达时刻 ≤ 该入信道关闭时刻（收到标记）→ 在接收方在途记录；\n  - 否则（截止后到达，或快照完成时仍未到达）→ 补记为发送方状态。\n","type":"text"}],"id":"msg_89c73d52928997997e77cc8b","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1489,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":110392,"output_tokens":3268,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"apiBlockIndex":1,"type":"assistant","uuid":"c9fb964b-8f7a-4b79-a7be-88c5f24b4b3a","timestamp":"2026-09-23T06:15:09.720Z","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp30/b","sessionId":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp30-b","slug":"glimmering-hopping-papert"}
{"parentUuid":"c9fb964b-8f7a-4b79-a7be-88c5f24b4b3a","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_mcq0ub487jc7po7uao37ub9e","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp30/b/internal/snap/manager.go","content":"// Package snap 实现 Chandy–Lamport 分布式快照算法。\n//\n// 前提（见论文条件）：\n//   - 信道可靠且 FIFO：标记与业务消息走同一信道，标记不会越过业务消息；\n//   - 节点收到某快照的第一个标记时：记录自身状态，并沿所有出信道发送该快照标记；\n//   - 节点在“已记录状态”到“收到来自某邻居的标记”之间收到的业务消息，\n//     全部记入该入信道的在途消息；\n//\n// 多个快照 ID 可以同时交叠进行，彼此状态完全隔离。\n//\n// 与“发起即扣款”银行模型的配套补记（out_after）：\n// 节点记录本地状态时，此前发起的转账可能尚未到对端。FIFO 下，在对端记录状态\n// 之后、入信道标记截止之前到达的钱会进入在途记录；但在入信道标记截止【之后】\n// 才到达（或快照完成时仍未到达）的钱，既不在发送方状态（已扣款）也不在对端\n// 状态/在途记录中。Build 时依据发送/投递日志把这部分金额补记为发送方状态的\n// OutAfter，保证全局切面每笔钱唯一归属一次。\npackage snap\n\nimport (\n\t\"sort\"\n\n\t\"simsnap/internal/msg\"\n)\n\n// MarkerSender 负责把快照标记真正送入网络。\ntype MarkerSender func(from, to, snapID int)\n\n// StateOf 返回节点当前待记录的状态。\ntype StateOf func(node int) any\n\n// SnapshotState 由可接收 out_after 补记的状态实现。\ntype SnapshotState interface {\n\tSetOutAfter(amount int)\n}\n\n// NodeState 是一个节点记录下来的本地状态。\ntype NodeState struct {\n\tNode    int   `json:\"node\"`\n\tState   any   `json:\"state\"`\n\tTakenAt int64 `json:\"taken_at\"`\n}\n\n// ChannelState 是一条有向信道在快照中的记录。\ntype ChannelState struct {\n\tFrom   int           `json:\"from\"`\n\tTo     int           `json:\"to\"`\n\tMsgs   []msg.Message `json:\"msgs\"`\n\tClosed bool          `json:\"closed\"`\n}\n\n// Snapshot 是一次全局快照（可能尚未完成）。\ntype Snapshot struct {\n\tID           int            `json:\"id\"`\n\tComplete     bool           `json:\"complete\"`\n\tCompleteAt   int64          `json:\"complete_at,omitempty\"`\n\tNodes        []NodeState    `json:\"nodes\"`\n\tChannels     []ChannelState `json:\"channels\"`\n\tMissingNodes []int          `json:\"missing_nodes,omitempty\"`\n\tOpenChannels [][2]int       `json:\"open_channels,omitempty\"`\n}\n\ntype chanRec struct {\n\tmsgs     []msg.Message\n\tclosed   bool\n\tclosedAt int64\n}\n\ntype nodeRec struct {\n\tdone    bool\n\tstate   any\n\ttakenAt int64\n\tin      map[int]*chanRec\n}\n\ntype snapState struct {\n\tid         int\n\tnodes      map[int]*nodeRec\n\tcomplete   bool\n\tcompleteAt int64\n}\n\ntype wireMsg struct {\n\tm       msg.Message\n\tarrived int64 // 0=截至 Build 尚未观测到投递\n}\n\n// Manager 管理若干个交叠进行的快照，所有方法仅在单线程事件循环中调用。\ntype Manager struct {\n\tn          int\n\tsnaps      map[int]*snapState\n\tsendMarker MarkerSender\n\tstateOf    StateOf\n\twire       []wireMsg\n}\n\n// NewManager 创建快照管理器。n 为节点数（全互联拓扑）。\nfunc NewManager(n int, sendMarker MarkerSender, stateOf StateOf) *Manager {\n\treturn &Manager{n: n, snaps: map[int]*snapState{}, sendMarker: sendMarker, stateOf: stateOf}\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) getOrCreate(id int) *snapState {\n\ts := m.snaps[id]\n\tif s == nil {\n\t\ts = &snapState{id: id, nodes: map[int]*nodeRec{}}\n\t\tm.snaps[id] = s\n\t}\n\treturn s\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) nodeRec(s *snapState, node int) *nodeRec {\n\tr := s.nodes[node]\n\tif r == nil {\n\t\tr = &nodeRec{in: map[int]*chanRec{}}\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif j != node {\n\t\t\t\tr.in[j] = &chanRec{}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\ts.nodes[node] = r\n\t}\n\treturn r\n}\n\n// NoteSend 在业务消息进入网络时调用（SentAt 须已填好）。\nfunc (m *Manager) NoteSend(message msg.Message) {\n\tfor _, w := range m.wire {\n\t\tif w.m.From == message.From && w.m.TxnID == message.TxnID {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tm.wire = append(m.wire, wireMsg{m: message})\n}\n\n// NoteDelivery 在业务消息实际投递时调用（重复副本只记首次到达时刻）。\nfunc (m *Manager) NoteDelivery(message msg.Message, at int64) {\n\tfor i := range m.wire {\n\t\tw := &m.wire[i]\n\t\tif w.m.From == message.From && w.m.TxnID == message.TxnID {\n\t\t\tif w.arrived == 0 {\n\t\t\t\tw.arrived = at\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tm.wire = append(m.wire, wireMsg{m: message, arrived: at})\n}\n\n// Initiate 由发起节点启动一次快照（幂等）。\nfunc (m *Manager) Initiate(id int, initiator int, at int64) bool {\n\tif _, ok := m.snaps[id]; ok {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\ts := m.getOrCreate(id)\n\tm.recordState(s, initiator, at)\n\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\tif j != initiator {\n\t\t\tm.sendMarker(initiator, j, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) recordState(s *snapState, node int, at int64) {\n\tr := m.nodeRec(s, node)\n\tif r.done {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tr.done = true\n\tr.state = m.stateOf(node)\n\tr.takenAt = at\n}\n\n// MarkerReceived 处理 node 收到来自 from 的快照标记。\nfunc (m *Manager) MarkerReceived(id, from, node int, at int64) {\n\ts := m.getOrCreate(id)\n\tr := m.nodeRec(s, node)\n\tif !r.done {\n\t\tm.recordState(s, node, at)\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif j != node {\n\t\t\t\tm.sendMarker(node, j, id)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif ch := r.in[from]; ch != nil && !ch.closed {\n\t\tch.closed = true\n\t\tch.closedAt = at\n\t}\n\tm.checkComplete(s, at)\n}\n\n// DataReceived 在 node 处理一条业务消息之前调用，返回该消息被哪些快照的在途记录捕获。\nfunc (m *Manager) DataReceived(from, node int, message msg.Message) []int {\n\tvar captured []int\n\tfor _, id := range m.activeIDs(node) {\n\t\ts := m.snaps[id]\n\t\tch := s.nodes[node].in[from]\n\t\tif ch != nil && !ch.closed {\n\t\t\tch.msgs = append(ch.msgs, message)\n\t\t\tcaptured = append(captured, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn captured\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) activeIDs(node int) []int {\n\tids := make([]int, 0)\n\tfor id, s := range m.snaps {\n\t\tif s.complete {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r := s.nodes[node]; r != nil && r.done {\n\t\t\tids = append(ids, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Ints(ids)\n\treturn ids\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) checkComplete(s *snapState, at int64) {\n\tif s.complete || len(s.nodes) != m.n {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tfor i := 0; i < m.n; i++ {\n\t\tr := s.nodes[i]\n\t\tif r == nil || !r.done {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif j != i {\n\t\t\t\tif ch := r.in[j]; ch == nil || !ch.closed {\n\t\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\ts.complete = true\n\ts.completeAt = at\n}\n\n// IsComplete 报告某快照是否已完成。\nfunc (m *Manager) IsComplete(id int) bool {\n\tif s := m.snaps[id]; s != nil {\n\t\treturn s.complete\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// CompletedIDs 返回所有已完成快照 ID（升序）。\nfunc (m *Manager) CompletedIDs() []int {\n\tvar ids []int\n\tfor id, s := range m.snaps {\n\t\tif s.complete {\n\t\t\tids = append(ids, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Ints(ids)\n\treturn ids\n}\n\n// outAfter 计算某快照中某节点“记录前已扣款发出、但既未进对端余额也未进在途记录”\n// 的金额合计。\nfunc (m *Manager) outAfter(s *snapState, node int) int {\n\tsender := s.nodes[node]\n\tif sender == nil || !sender.done {\n\t\treturn 0\n\t}\n\ttotal := 0\n\tfor _, w := range m.wire {\n\t\tmm := w.m\n\t\tif mm.From != node || mm.SentAt >= sender.takenAt {\n\t\t\tcontinue // 切面之后才发出，与本快照无关\n\t\t}\n\t\tpeer := s.nodes[mm.To]\n\t\tif peer == nil || !peer.done {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif w.arrived != 0 && w.arrived < peer.takenAt {\n\t\t\tcontinue // 对端记录之前到账：已进对端余额\n\t\t}\n\t\tch := peer.in[node]\n\t\tif w.arrived != 0 && ch != nil && w.arrived <= ch.closedAt {\n\t\t\tcontinue // 在途窗口内到达：已在对端在途记录中\n\t\t}\n\t\t// 截止后到达，或快照完成时尚未到达：补记到发送方。\n\t\ttotal += mm.Amount\n\t}\n\treturn total\n}\n\n// Build 生成某快照的可序列化报告（无论是否完成都可调用）。\nfunc (m *Manager) Build(id int) Snapshot {\n\ts := m.snaps[id]\n\tout := Snapshot{ID: FIFO：标记与业务消息走同一信道，标记不会越过业务消息；\n//   - 节点收到某快照的第一个标记时：记录自身状态，并沿所有出信道发送该快照标记；\n//   - 节点在“已记录状态”到“收到来自某邻居的标记”之间收到的业务消息，\n//     全部记入该入信道的在途消息；\n//\n// 多个快照 ID 可以同时交叠进行，彼此状态完全隔离。\npackage snap\n\nimport (\n\t\"sort\"\n\n\t\"simsnap/internal/msg\"\n)\n\n// MarkerSender 负责把快照标记真正送入网络（由应用层注入，避免本包依赖网络实现）。\ntype MarkerSender func(from, to, snapID int)\n\n// StateOf 在节点 node 为快照 snapID 记录本地状态的同一刻返回待记录的状态。\n// 应用层应在此回调中完成“记录时刻在途出账”的账务结算（见 bank 包）。\ntype StateOf func(node, snapID int, at int64) any\n\n// OnMarker 在节点收到某入信道标记、该信道在途记录关闭之后回调（参数：node 收信方, from 发信方）。\n// 应用层可借此释放与该方向对应的记账槽位。\ntype OnMarker func(node, from, snapID int, at int64)\n\n// NodeState 是一个节点记录下来的本地状态。\ntype NodeState struct {\n\tNode    int   `json:\"node\"`\n\tState   any   `json:\"state\"`\n\tTakenAt int64 `json:\"taken_at\"`\n}\n\n// ChannelState 是一条有向信道在快照中的记录。\ntype ChannelState struct {\n\tFrom   int           `json:\"from\"`\n\tTo     int           `json:\"to\"`\n\tMsgs   []msg.Message `json:\"msgs\"`\n\tClosed bool          `json:\"closed\"`\n}\n\n// Snapshot 是一次全局快照（可能尚未完成）。\ntype Snapshot struct {\n\tID           int            `json:\"id\"`\n\tComplete     bool           `json:\"complete\"`\n\tCompleteAt   int64          `json:\"complete_at,omitempty\"`\n\tNodes        []NodeState    `json:\"nodes\"`        // 已记录状态的节点（按节点号排序）\n\tChannels     []ChannelState `json:\"channels\"`     // 在记录窗口内捕到过消息的入信道\n\tMissingNodes []int          `json:\"missing_nodes,omitempty\"`\n\tOpenChannels [][2]int       `json:\"open_channels,omitempty\"` // 尚未关闭的入信道\n}\n\ntype chanRec struct {\n\tmsgs     []msg.Message\n\tclosed   bool\n\tclosedAt int64\n}\n\ntype nodeRec struct {\n\tdone    bool\n\tstate   any\n\ttakenAt int64\n\tin      map[int]*chanRec // in[peer] = 信道 peer->本节点 的记录\n}\n\ntype snapState struct {\n\tid         int\n\tnodes      map[int]*nodeRec\n\tcomplete   bool\n\tcompleteAt int64\n}\n\n// Manager 管理若干个交叠进行的快照，所有方法仅在单线程事件循环中调用。\ntype Manager struct {\n\tn          int\n\tsnaps      map[int]*snapState\n\tsendMarker MarkerSender\n\tstateOf    StateOf\n\tonMarker   OnMarker\n}\n\n// NewManager 创建快照管理器。n 为节点数（节点编号 0..n-1，全互联拓扑）。\nfunc NewManager(n int, sendMarker MarkerSender, stateOf StateOf, onMarker OnMarker) *Manager {\n\tif onMarker == nil {\n\t\tonMarker = 的转账：立即扣款并发消息。余额不足返回 false。\nfunc (n *Node) Transfer(to, amount int, at int64) bool {\n\tif amount <= 0 {\n\t\tpanic(fmt.Sprintf(\"bank: 转账金额必须为正: %d\", amount))\n\t}\n\tif amount > n.balance {\n\t\tn.log(Event{At: at, Node: n.id, Kind: \"insufficient\", Peer: to, Amount: amount, Balance: n.balance})\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tn.txnSeq++\n\ttxn := n.txnSeq\n\tn.balance -= 记录状态中余额之和\n\tInFlight int           `json:\"in_flight\"` // 在途转账金额之和\n\tTotal    int           `json:\"total\"`     // node_sum + in_flight\n\tExpected int           `json:\"expected\"`  // n; b++ {\n\t\t\tnetw.AddLink(a, b, policies[pairKey(a, b)])\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tevents := []LogEvent{}\n\tlogf := func(e LogEvent) { events = append(events, e) }\n\n\tnodes := make([]*bank.Node, Run(r *Request) *Response {\n\tn := len(r.Balances)\n\teng := sim.NewEngine(r.Seed)\n\tif r.Deadline > 0 {\n\t\teng.SetDeadline(r.Deadline)\n\t}\n\tnetw := sim.NewNetwork(eng)\n\tpolicies, _ := r.Validate()\n\tfor a := 0; a < n; a++ {\n\t\tfor b := a + 1; b < n; b++ {\n\t\t\tnetw.AddLink(a, b, policies[pairKey(a, b)])\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tevents := []LogEvent{}\n\tlogf := func(e LogEvent) { events = append(events, e) }\n\n\tnodes := make([]*bank.Node, n)\n\tvar mgr *snap.Manager\n\tlogComplete := func(id int, at int64) {\n\t\tif mgr == nil || !mgr.IsComplete(id) {\n\t\t\tbs[i] = nd.Balance()\n\t\t}\n\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: at, Kind: EvComplete, SnapID: id, Balances: bs})\n\t}\n\n\tvar send func(m msg.Message)\n\tsend = func(m msg.Message) {\n\t\tif !m.IsMarker() {\n\t\t\tm.SentAt = eng.Now()\n\t\t\tmgr.NoteSend(m)\n\t\t}\n\t\tnetw.Send(m, func(d sim.Delivery) {\n\t\t\tmm := d.Msg\n\t\t\tif mm.IsMarker() {\n\t\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: d.At, Kind: },\n\t)\n\n\tinitialTotal := 0\n\tfor _, b := range r.Balances {\n\t\tinitialTotal += b\n\t}\n\n\t// 脚本化事件：先排序保证调度顺序确定（同刻按发起方排序）。\n\ttransfers := append([]TransferEvent(nil), {"parentUuid":"85150ab0-e247-4676-b7b0-7664c0c51764","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"text":"发现一个严重 bug：`netw.Send` 内修改的 `m` 是入参副本，调用方（wiring 的 `send`）闭包变量没被更新，导致 `SentAt=0`，`outAfter` 把所有记录前发出的消息都误判成\"未到达\"——同时还有个奇怪现象：marker 也计入了 stats.sent。查 network.Send，它其实返回 id 但没回写消息。修正：让 `Send` 返回填好的消息，wiring 用返回值；同时 01 的 190 需要再查。先修消息回传：\n","type":"text"}],"id":"msg_4c7928b4ede9f8c6503cde5b","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1317,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":118584,"output_tokens":1236,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"apiBlockIndex":1,"type":"assistant","uuid":"6b9e9ff6-92ac-49d1-809f-e2e9b241d119","timestamp":"2026-09-23T06:19:28.393Z","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp30/b","sessionId":"4a033135-56a3-4da5-b2f6-a6fc613c7ee0","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp30-b","slug":"glimmering-hopping-papert"}

int, policy Policy) {\n\tk := linkKey(a, b)\n\tn.links[k] = &link{policy: policy}\n}\n\n// Send 在 m.From -> m.To 方向发送一条逻辑消息。\n// 返回该消息在该方向信道上的发送编号；消息被丢弃时编号仍然占用。\n// onDeliver 在每个实际投递的副本（可能重复）发生时被调用。\nfunc (n *Network) Send(m msg.Message, onDeliver func(Delivery)) int {\n\tl := n.links[linkKey(m.From, m.To)]\n\tif l == nil {\n\t\tpanic(fmt.Sprintf(\"sim: 节点 %d 与 %d 之间不存在链路\", m.From, m.To))\n\t}\n\n\tl.lastSent++\n\tid := l.lastSent\n\tm.MsgID = id\n\tm.SentAt = n.eng.Now()\n\tl.stats.Sent++\n\n\t// 随机量的抽取顺序固定，保证同种子完全可复现。\n\tlost := l.policy.LossPct > 0 && n.eng.RNG().Intn(100) < l.policy.LossPct\n\tif lost {\n\t\tl.stats.Lost++\n\t\treturn m\n\t}\n\n\tduplicate := l.policy.DupPct > 0 && n.eng.RNG().Intn(100) < l.policy.DupPct\n\n\tspan := l.policy.MaxDelay - l.policy.MinDelay + 1\n\tdelay := l.policy.MinDelay\n\tif span > 1 {\n\t\tdelay += n.eng.RNG().Int63n(span)\n\t}\n\tat := n.eng.Now() + delay\n\tif l.policy.FIFO && at < l.nextArrival {\n\t\t// FIFO：延迟较大的先发消息会“顶住”后发消息的最早投递时刻。\n\t\tat = l.nextArrival\n\t}\n\tl.nextArrival = at + 1\n\n\tn.schedule(l, m, id, at, false, onDeliver)\n\tif duplicate {\n\t\t// 重复副本在原副本之后、仍满足 FIFO 的时刻投递。\n\t\tdat := at + 1\n\t\tif l.policy.FIFO {\n\t\t\tdat = l.nextArrival\n\t\t}\n\t\tl.nextArrival = dat + 1\n\t\tn.schedule(l, m, id, dat, true, onDeliver)\n\t}\n\treturn m\n}\n\nfunc (n *Network) schedule(l *link, m msg.Message, id int, at int64, dup bool, onDeliver func(Delivery)) {\n\tn.eng.ScheduleAt(at, 1, func(now int64) {\n\t\tl.stats.Delivered++\n\t\tif dup {\n\t\t\tl.stats.Duplicated++\n\t\t}\n\t\tif id < l.lastDeliv {\n\t\t\tl.stats.Reordered++\n\t\t}\n\t\tl.lastDeliv = id\n\t\tonDeliver(Delivery{Msg: m, SendID: id, At: now, Dup: dup})\n\t})\n}\n\n// Stats 返回 a->b 方向的链路统计副本。\nfunc (n *Network) Stats(a, b int) Stats {\n\tif l := n.links[linkKey(a, b)]; l != nil {\n\t\treturn l.stats\n\t}\n\treturn Stats{}\n}\n\n// Policy 返回 a->b 方向的策略副本。\nfunc (n *Network) Policy(a, b int) Policy {\n\tif l := n.links[linkKey(a, b)]; l != nil {\n\t\treturn l.policy\n\t}\n\treturn `json:\"dup,omitempty\"`\n\tNote     string `json:\"note,omitempty\"`\n\tBalances []int  `json:\"balances,omitempty\"` // 仅 snap_complete：完成时刻各节点余额\n}\n\n// SnapshotResult 是单次快照的结果。\ntype SnapshotResult struct {\n\tSnapshot snap.Snapshot `json:\"snapshot\"`\n\tNodeSum  int           `json:\"node_sum\"`  // 记录状态中余额之和\n\tInFlight int           `json:\"in_flight\"` // 在途转账金额之和\n\tTotal    int           `json:\"total\"`     // node_sum + in_flight\n\tExpected int           `json:\"expected\"`  // 初始总余额（守恒参照）\n\tConserved bool         `json:\"conserved\"` // complete && total == expected\n}\n\n// BalanceEntry 是结束时某节点余额。\ntype BalanceEntry struct {\n\tNode    int `json:\"node\"`\n\tBalance int `json:\"balance\"`\n}\n\n// LinkStat 是一条有向信道的结束统计。\ntype LinkStat struct {\n\tFrom `json:\"network\"`\n\tEvents          []LogEvent       `json:\"events\"`\n\tStoppedDeadline bool             `json:\"stopped_by_deadline,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Run 执行请求并返回结果。请求必须已通过 Validate。\nfunc r.Validate()\n\tfor a := 0; a < n; a++ {\n\t\tfor b := a + 1; b < n; b++ {\n\t\t\tnetw.AddLink(a, b, policies[pairKey(a, b)])\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tevents := []LogEvent{}\n\tlogf := func(e LogEvent) { range m.wire {\n\t\tif w.m.From == message.From && w.m.TxnID == message.TxnID {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tm.wire = append(m.wire, wireMsg{m: message})\n}\n\n// SetSentAt 补记已登记消息的发送时刻（网络层在 Send 时统一打戳）。\nfunc (m *Manager) SetSentAt(from int, txn int64, sentAt int64) {\n\tfor i := range m.wire {\n\t\tw := &m.wire[i]\n\t\tif w.m.From == from && w.m.TxnID == txn {\n\t\t\tw.m.SentAt = sentAt\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}","originalFile":"// Package snap 实现 Chandy–Lamport 分布式快照算法。\n//\n// 前提（见论文条件）：\n//   - 信道可靠且 FIFO：标记与业务消息走同一信道，标记不会越过业务消息；\n//   - 节点收到某快照的第一个标记时：记录自身状态，并沿所有出信道发送该快照标记；\n//   - 节点在“已记录状态”到“收到来自某邻居的标记”之间收到的业务消息，\n//     全部记入该入信道的在途消息；\n//\n// 多个快照 ID 可以同时交叠进行，彼此状态完全隔离。\n//\n// 与“发起即扣款”银行模型的配套补记（out_after）：\n// 节点记录本地状态时，此前发起的转账可能尚未到对端。FIFO 下，在对端记录状态\n// 之后、入信道标记截止之前到达的钱会进入在途记录；但在入信道标记截止【之后】\n// 才到达（或快照完成时仍未到达）的钱，既不在发送方状态（已扣款）也不在对端\n// 状态/在途记录中。Build 时依据发送/投递日志把这部分金额补记为发送方状态的\n// OutAfter，保证全局切面每笔钱唯一归属一次。\npackage snap\n\nimport (\n\t\"sort\"\n\n\t\"simsnap/internal/msg\"\n)\n\n// MarkerSender 负责把快照标记真正送入网络。\ntype MarkerSender func(from, to, snapID int)\n\n// StateOf 返回节点当前待记录的状态。\ntype StateOf func(node int) any\n\n// SnapshotState 由可接收 out_after 补记的状态实现。\ntype SnapshotState interface {\n\tSetOutAfter(amount int)\n}\n\n// NodeState 是一个节点记录下来的本地状态。\ntype NodeState struct {\n\tNode    int   `json:\"node\"`\n\tState   any   `json:\"state\"`\n\tTakenAt int64 `json:\"taken_at\"`\n}\n\n// ChannelState 是一条有向信道在快照中的记录。\ntype ChannelState struct {\n\tFrom   int           `json:\"from\"`\n\tTo     int           `json:\"to\"`\n\tMsgs   []msg.Message `json:\"msgs\"`\n\tClosed bool          `json:\"closed\"`\n}\n\n// Snapshot 是一次全局快照（可能尚未完成）。\ntype Snapshot struct {\n\tID           int            `json:\"id\"`\n\tComplete     bool           `json:\"complete\"`\n\tCompleteAt   int64          `json:\"complete_at,omitempty\"`\n\tNodes        []NodeState    `json:\"nodes\"`\n\tChannels     []ChannelState `json:\"channels\"`\n\tMissingNodes []int          `json:\"missing_nodes,omitempty\"`\n\tOpenChannels [][2]int       `json:\"open_channels,omitempty\"`\n}\n\ntype chanRec struct {\n\tmsgs     []msg.Message\n\tclosed   bool\n\tclosedAt int64\n}\n\ntype nodeRec struct {\n\tdone    bool\n\tstate   any\n\ttakenAt int64\n\tin      map[int]*chanRec\n}\n\ntype snapState struct {\n\tid         int\n\tnodes      map[int]*nodeRec\n\tcomplete   bool\n\tcompleteAt int64\n}\n\ntype wireMsg struct {\n\tm       msg.Message\n\tarrived int64 // 0=截至 Build 尚未观测到投递\n}\n\n// Manager 管理若干个交叠进行的快照，所有方法仅在单线程事件循环中调用。\ntype Manager struct {\n\tn          int\n\tsnaps      map[int]*snapState\n\tsendMarker MarkerSender\n\tstateOf    StateOf\n\twire       []wireMsg\n}\n\n// NewManager 创建快照管理器。n 为节点数（全互联拓扑）。\nfunc NewManager(n int, sendMarker MarkerSender, stateOf StateOf) *Manager {\n\treturn &Manager{n: n, snaps: map[int]*snapState{}, sendMarker: sendMarker, stateOf: stateOf}\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) getOrCreate(id int) *snapState {\n\ts := m.snaps[id]\n\tif s == nil {\n\t\ts = &snapState{id: id, nodes: map[int]*nodeRec{}}\n\t\tm.snaps[id] = s\n\t}\n\treturn s\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) nodeRec(s *snapState, node int) *nodeRec {\n\tr := s.nodes[node]\n\tif r == nil {\n\t\tr = &nodeRec{in: map[int]*chanRec{}}\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif j != node {\n\t\t\t\tr.in[j] = &chanRec{}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\ts.nodes[node] = r\n\t}\n\treturn r\n}\n\n// NoteSend 在业务消息进入网络时调用（SentAt 须已填好）。\nfunc (m *Manager) NoteSend(message msg.Message) {\n\tfor _, w := range m.wire {\n\t\tif w.m.From == message.From && w.m.TxnID == message.TxnID {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tm.wire = append(m.wire, wireMsg{m: message})\n}\n\n// NoteDelivery 在业务消息实际投递时调用（重复副本只记首次到达时刻）。\nfunc (m *Manager) NoteDelivery(message msg.Message, at int64) {\n\tfor i := range m.wire {\n\t\tw := &m.wire[i]\n\t\tif w.m.From == message.From && w.m.TxnID == message.TxnID {\n\t\t\tif w.arrived == 0 {\n\t\t\t\tw.arrived = at\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tm.wire = append(m.wire, wireMsg{m: message, arrived: at})\n}\n\n// Initiate 由发起节点启动一次快照（幂等）。\nfunc (m *Manager) Initiate(id int, initiator int, at int64) bool {\n\tif _, ok := m.snaps[id]; ok {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\ts := m.getOrCreate(id)\n\tm.recordState(s, initiator, at)\n\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\tif j != initiator {\n\t\t\tm.sendMarker(initiator, j, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) recordState(s *snapState, node int, at int64) {\n\tr := m.nodeRec(s, node)\n\tif r.done {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tr.done = true\n\tr.state = m.stateOf(node)\n\tr.takenAt = at\n}\n\n// MarkerReceived 处理 node 收到来自 from 的快照标记。\nfunc (m *Manager) MarkerReceived(id, from, node int, at int64) {\n\ts := m.getOrCreate(id)\n\tr := m.nodeRec(s, node)\n\tif !r.done {\n\t\tm.recordState(s, node, at)\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif j != node {\n\t\t\t\tm.sendMarker(node, j, id)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif ch := r.in[from]; ch != nil && !ch.closed {\n\t\tch.closed = true\n\t\tch.closedAt = at\n\t}\n\tm.checkComplete(s, at)\n}\n\n// DataReceived 在 node 处理一条业务消息之前调用，返回该消息被哪些快照的在途记录捕获。\nfunc (m *Manager) DataReceived(from, node int, message msg.Message) []int {\n\tvar captured []int\n\tfor _, id := range m.activeIDs(node) {\n\t\ts := m.snaps[id]\n\t\tch := s.nodes[node].in[from]\n\t\tif ch != nil && !ch.closed {\n\t\t\tch.msgs = append(ch.msgs, message)\n\t\t\tcaptured = append(captured, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn captured\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) activeIDs(node int) []int {\n\tids := make([]int, 0)\n\tfor id, s := range m.snaps {\n\t\tif s.complete {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r := s.nodes[node]; r != nil && r.done {\n\t\t\tids = append(ids, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Ints(ids)\n\treturn ids\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) checkComplete(s *snapState, at int64) {\n\tif s.complete || len(s.nodes) != m.n {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tfor i := 0; i < m.n; i++ {\n\t\tr := s.nodes[i]\n\t\tif r == nil || !r.done {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif j != i {\n\t\t\t\tif ch := r.in[j]; ch == nil || !ch.closed {\n\t\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\ts.complete = true\n\ts.completeAt = at\n}\n\n// IsComplete 报告某快照是否已完成。\nfunc (m *Manager) IsComplete(id int) bool {\n\tif s := m.snaps[id]; s != nil {\n\t\treturn s.complete\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// CompletedIDs 返回所有已完成快照 ID（升序）。\nfunc (m *Manager) CompletedIDs() []int {\n\tvar ids []int\n\tfor id, s := range m.snaps {\n\t\tif s.complete {\n\t\t\tids = append(ids, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Ints(ids)\n\treturn ids\n}\n\n// outAfter  = \"snap_complete\"\n)\n\n// LogEvent 是时间线日志条目。\ntype LogEvent struct {\n\tAt       int64  `json:\"at\"`\n\tKind     string `json:\"kind\"`\n\tSnapID   int    `json:\"snap_id,omitempty\"`\n\tFrom 记录状态中余额之和\n\tInFlight int           `json:\"in_flight\"` // 在途转账金额之和\n\tTotal    int           `json:\"total\"`     // node_sum + in_flight\n\tExpected int           `json:\"expected\"`  // `json:\"balance\"`\n}\n\n// LinkStat 是一条有向信道的结束统计。\ntype LinkStat struct {\n\tFrom  int       `json:\"from\"`\n\tTo    int       `json:\"to\"`\n\tStats sim.Stats `json:\"stats\"`\n}\n\n// Response `json:\"deadline\"`\n\tInitialTotal    int              `json:\"initial_total\"`\n\tFinalBalances   []BalanceEntry   `json:\"final_balances\"`\n\tFinalTotal      int              `json:\"final_total\"`\n\tSnapshots       []SnapshotResult `json:\"snapshots\"`\n\tNetwork         []LinkStat       `json:\"network\"`\n\tEvents          []LogEvent := sim.NewEngine(r.Seed)\n\tif r.Deadline > 0 {\n\t\teng.SetDeadline(r.Deadline)\n\t}\n\tnetw := sim.NewNetwork(eng)\n\tpolicies, _ := r.Validate()\n\tfor a := 0; a < n; a++ {\n\t\tfor b := a + 1; b < n; b++ {\n\t\t\tnetw.AddLink(a, b, policies[pairKey(a, b)])\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tevents := []LogEvent{}\n\tlogf := func(e LogEvent) { events = append(events, e) }\n\n\tnodes := make([]*bank.Node, && e.SnapID == id {\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tbs := make([]int, n)\n\t\tfor i, nd := range nodes {\n\t\t\tbs[i] = nd.Balance()\n\t\t}\n\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: at, Kind: EvComplete, SnapID: id, Balances: bs})\n\t}\n\n\tvar send func(m msg.Message)\n\tsend = func(m msg.Message) {\n\t\tisMarker := m.IsMarker()\n\t\tif !isMarker {\n\t\t\tmgr.NoteSend(m) // SentAt 会在网络层填好，登记时先占位、投递时补时刻\n\t\t}\n\t\tsent := netw.Send(m, func(d sim.Delivery) {\n\t\t\tmm := d.Msg\n\t\t\tif mm.IsMarker() {\n\t\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: d.At, Kind: EvMarkerDeliver, SnapID: {\n\t\t\treturn transfers[i].At < transfers[j].At\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn transfers[i].From < transfers[j].From\n\t})\n\tfor _, t := range transfers {\n\t\tt := t\n\t\teng.ScheduleAt(t.At, 0, func(now int64) {\n\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: now, Kind: EvScheduleTransfer, From: t.From, To: t.To, Amount: t.Amount})\n\t\t\tnodes[t.From].Transfer(t.To, t.Amount, now)\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\tsnaps := 1\n\t\t\t\tlogf(LogEvent{At: now, Kind: EvScheduleTransfer, From: from, To: to, Amount: amount})\n\t\t\t\tnodes[from].Transfer(to, amount, now) // 余额不足时节点自身跳过\n\t\t\t\tscheduleTick(now + id := range mgr.CompletedIDs() {\n\t\tallSnapIDs[id] = true\n\t}\n\tids := make([]int, 0, len(allSnapIDs))\n\tfor id := range allSnapIDs {\n\t\tids = append(ids, id)\n\t}\n\tsort.Ints(ids)\n\tresp := &Response{\n\t\tSeed:         r.Seed,\n\t\tNow:          eng.Now(),\n\t\tDeadline:     r.Deadline,\n\t\tInitialTotal: initialTotal,\n\t\tEvents:       events,\n\t}\n\tfor _, id := range ids {\n\t\ts Build 时补记：记录前发出、对端截止后才到达/未到达的金额\n}","originalFile":"// Package snap 实现 Chandy–Lamport 分布式快照算法。\n//\n// 前提（见论文条件）：\n//   - 信道可靠且 FIFO：标记与业务消息走同一信道，标记不会越过业务消息；\n//   - 节点收到某快照的第一个标记时：记录自身状态，并沿所有出信道发送该快照标记；\n//   - 节点在“已记录状态”到“收到来自某邻居的标记”之间收到的业务消息，\n//     全部记入该入信道的在途消息；\n//\n// 多个快照 ID 可以同时交叠进行，彼此状态完全隔离。\n//\n// 与“发起即扣款”银行模型的配套补记（out_after）：\n// 节点记录本地状态时，此前发起的转账可能尚未到对端。FIFO 下，在对端记录状态\n// 之后、入信道标记截止之前到达的钱会进入在途记录；但在入信道标记截止【之后】\n// 才到达（或快照完成时仍未到达）的钱，既不在发送方状态（已扣款）也不在对端\n// 状态/在途记录中。Build 时依据发送/投递日志把这部分金额补记为发送方状态的\n// OutAfter，保证全局切面每笔钱唯一归属一次。\npackage snap\n\nimport (\n\t\"sort\"\n\n\t\"simsnap/internal/msg\"\n)\n\n// MarkerSender 负责把快照标记真正送入网络。\ntype MarkerSender func(from, to, snapID int)\n\n// StateOf 返回节点当前待记录的状态。\ntype StateOf func(node int) any\n\n// SnapshotState 由可接收 out_after 补记的状态实现。\ntype SnapshotState interface {\n\tSetOutAfter(amount int)\n}\n\n// NodeState 是一个节点记录下来的本地状态。\ntype NodeState struct {\n\tNode    int   `json:\"node\"`\n\tState   any   `json:\"state\"`\n\tTakenAt int64 `json:\"taken_at\"`\n}\n\n// ChannelState 是一条有向信道在快照中的记录。\ntype ChannelState struct {\n\tFrom   int           `json:\"from\"`\n\tTo     int           `json:\"to\"`\n\tMsgs   []msg.Message `json:\"msgs\"`\n\tClosed bool          `json:\"closed\"`\n}\n\n// Snapshot 是一次全局快照（可能尚未完成）。\ntype Snapshot struct {\n\tID           int            `json:\"id\"`\n\tComplete     bool           `json:\"complete\"`\n\tCompleteAt   int64          `json:\"complete_at,omitempty\"`\n\tNodes        []NodeState    `json:\"nodes\"`\n\tChannels     []ChannelState `json:\"channels\"`\n\tMissingNodes []int          `json:\"missing_nodes,omitempty\"`\n\tOpenChannels [][2]int       `json:\"open_channels,omitempty\"`\n}\n\ntype chanRec struct {\n\tmsgs     []msg.Message\n\tclosed   bool\n\tclosedAt int64\n}\n\ntype nodeRec struct {\n\tdone    bool\n\tstate   any\n\ttakenAt int64\n\tin      map[int]*chanRec\n}\n\ntype snapState struct {\n\tid         int\n\tnodes      map[int]*nodeRec\n\tcomplete   bool\n\tcompleteAt int64\n}\n\ntype wireMsg struct {\n\tm       msg.Message\n\tarrived int64 // 0=截至 Build 尚未观测到投递\n}\n\n// Manager 管理若干个交叠进行的快照，所有方法仅在单线程事件循环中调用。\ntype Manager struct {\n\tn          int\n\tsnaps      map[int]*snapState\n\tsendMarker MarkerSender\n\tstateOf    StateOf\n\twire       []wireMsg\n}\n\n// NewManager 创建快照管理器。n 为节点数（全互联拓扑）。\nfunc NewManager(n int, sendMarker MarkerSender, stateOf StateOf) *Manager {\n\treturn &Manager{n: n, snaps: map[int]*snapState{}, sendMarker: sendMarker, stateOf: stateOf}\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) getOrCreate(id int) *snapState {\n\ts := m.snaps[id]\n\tif s == nil {\n\t\ts = &snapState{id: id, nodes: map[int]*nodeRec{}}\n\t\tm.snaps[id] = s\n\t}\n\treturn s\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) nodeRec(s *snapState, node int) *nodeRec {\n\tr := s.nodes[node]\n\tif r == nil {\n\t\tr = &nodeRec{in: map[int]*chanRec{}}\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif j != node {\n\t\t\t\tr.in[j] = &chanRec{}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\ts.nodes[node] = r\n\t}\n\treturn r\n}\n\n// NoteSend 记录一条业务消息的发送（按 From+TxnID 去重）。\nfunc (m *Manager) NoteSend(message msg.Message) {\n\tfor _, w := range m.wire {\n\t\tif w.m.From == message.From && w.m.TxnID == message.TxnID {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tm.wire = append(m.wire, wireMsg{m: message})\n}\n\n// SetSentAt 补记已登记消息的发送时刻（网络层在 Send 时统一打戳）。\nfunc (m *Manager) SetSentAt(from int, txn int64, sentAt int64) {\n\tfor i := range m.wire {\n\t\tw := &m.wire[i]\n\t\tif w.m.From == from && w.m.TxnID == txn {\n\t\t\tw.m.SentAt = sentAt\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// NoteDelivery 在业务消息实际投递时调用（重复副本只记首次到达时刻）。\nfunc (m *Manager) NoteDelivery(message msg.Message, at int64) {\n\tfor i := range m.wire {\n\t\tw := &m.wire[i]\n\t\tif w.m.From == message.From && w.m.TxnID == message.TxnID {\n\t\t\tif w.arrived == 0 {\n\t\t\t\tw.arrived = at\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tm.wire = append(m.wire, wireMsg{m: message, arrived: at})\n}\n\n// Initiate 由发起节点启动一次快照（幂等）。\nfunc (m *Manager) Initiate(id int, initiator int, at int64) bool {\n\tif _, ok := m.snaps[id]; ok {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\ts := m.getOrCreate(id)\n\tm.recordState(s, initiator, at)\n\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\tif j != initiator {\n\t\t\tm.sendMarker(initiator, j, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) recordState(s *snapState, node int, at int64) {\n\tr := m.nodeRec(s, node)\n\tif r.done {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tr.done = true\n\tr.state = m.stateOf(node)\n\tr.takenAt = at\n}\n\n// MarkerReceived 处理 node 收到来自 from 的快照标记。\nfunc (m *Manager) MarkerReceived(id, from, node int, at int64) {\n\ts := m.getOrCreate(id)\n\tr := m.nodeRec(s, node)\n\tif !r.done {\n\t\tm.recordState(s, node, at)\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < m.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif j != node {\n\t\t\t\tm.sendMarker(node, j, id)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif ch := r.in[from]; ch != nil && !ch.closed {\n\t\tch.closed = true\n\t\tch.closedAt = at\n\t}\n\tm.checkComplete(s, at)\n}\n\n// DataReceived 在 node 处理一条业务消息之前调用，返回该消息被哪些快照的在途记录捕获。\nfunc (m *Manager) DataReceived(from, node int, message msg.Message) []int {\n\tvar captured []int\n\tfor _, id := range m.activeIDs(node) {\n\t\ts := m.snaps[id]\n\t\tch := s.nodes[node].in[from]\n\t\tif ch != nil && !ch.closed {\n\t\t\tch.msgs = append(ch.msgs, message)\n\t\t\tcaptured = append(captured, id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn captured\n}\n\nfunc (m *Manager) activeIDs(node int) []int {\n\tids := make([]int, 0)\n\tfor id, s := range m.snaps {\n\t\tif s.complete {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r := s.nodes[node]; r != nil
